title.en: Volume 333 Biographies 120: Wu Dai, Wu Fu, Hai Lu, Cheng De, Ma Biao, Chang Qing, Guan Da Se, Wu Shenhada, Hu Ni Lei Tu, Ao Cheng, Tu Qin Bao, Mu Ta Er, Dai Sen Bao, Weng Guoerhai, Zhu Er Hang A, Zhe Sen Bao

sentences.zh: 列傳一百二十

translations.literal: Biographies 120
translations.idiomatic: Biographies 120

sentences.zh: 五岱五福海祿成德馬彪常青

translations.literal: Wu Dai, Wu Fu, Hai Lu, Cheng De, Ma Biao, Chang Qing
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dai, Wu Fu, Hai Lu, Cheng De, Ma Biao, and Chang Qing

sentences.zh: 官達色烏什哈達瑚尼勒圖敖成圖欽保木塔爾

translations.literal: Guan Da Se, Wu Shenhada, Hu Ni Le Tu, Ao Cheng, Tu Qin Bao, Mu Ta Er
translations.idiomatic: Guan Da Se, Wu Shenhada, Hu Ni Le Tu, Ao Cheng, Tu Qin Bao, and Mu Ta Er

sentences.zh: 岱森保翁果爾海珠爾杭阿哲森保

translations.literal: Dai Sen Bao, Weng Guoerhai, Zhu Er Hang A, Zhe Sen Bao
translations.idiomatic: Dai Sen Bao, Weng Guoerhai, Zhu Er Hang A, and Zhe Sen Bao

sentences.zh: 五岱，瓜爾佳氏，黑龍江人。

translations.literal: Wu Dai, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a native of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dai, of the Guwalgiya clan, came from Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十八年，命隸滿洲正黃旗。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of the Qianlong reign, he was ordered to be enrolled in the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 18 (1753), he was assigned to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 初以前鋒從征準噶爾，授三等侍衛，賜墨爾根巴圖魯名號。

translations.literal: At first, as a vanguard he followed the campaign against the Dzungars and was appointed a third-rank bodyguard, receiving the title name Merigen Batüru.
translations.idiomatic: He first served as a vanguard in the Dzungar campaign and was made a third-rank bodyguard, with the honorific name Merigen Batüru.

sentences.zh: 戰葉爾羌，复遷二等侍衛。

translations.literal: In battle at Yarkand he was again promoted to second-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: After fighting at Yarkand, he was promoted again to second-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 霍罕使者至，命往宣諭，授正黃旗漢軍副都統，賜騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: When a Kokand envoy arrived, he was ordered to go proclaim the imperial will; he was appointed deputy lieutenant-general of the Han Army of the Plain Yellow Banner and granted a hereditary office as Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: When envoys from Kokand arrived, he was sent to deliver the imperial message; he was then appointed deputy lieutenant-general of the Han Army of the Plain Yellow Banner and granted a hereditary commandant of cavalry.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，從將軍溫福討金川，授參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year he followed General Wen Fu to suppress the Jinchuan rebels and was appointed Grand Minister Consultant.
translations.idiomatic: In year 36 he joined General Wen Fu in the Jinchuan campaign and was made a commissioner-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 攻巴朗拉，克之，授正黃旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: He attacked Balangla and captured it, and was appointed lieutenant-general of the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He stormed Balangla and took it, and was appointed lieutenant-general of the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 京旗目吉林、黑龍江諸部人為烏拉齊，鄙之不與為伍，溫福以是輕五岱。

translations.literal: The capital banners looked down on the ulaqi from the Jilin and Heilongjiang departments and would not associate with them; Wen Fu therefore held Wu Dai in contempt.
translations.idiomatic: Men of the capital banners despised the ulaqi drawn from Jilin and Heilongjiang and would not mix with them, and Wen Fu for that reason looked down on Wu Dai.

sentences.zh: 五岱密疏言：「溫福在軍好安逸，不親督戰，自以為是，寒將士之心。

translations.literal: Wu Dai submitted a secret memorial saying: 'Wen Fu in the army loves ease and does not personally supervise battle; he considers himself always in the right and chills the hearts of officers and soldiers.'
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dai sent a secret memorial stating that Wen Fu, while in command, loved comfort, failed to lead troops in person, presumed he was always right, and thereby chilled the army's morale.

sentences.zh: 」溫福亦劾：「五岱剛愎自用，自成都至軍，途中奪驛馬騷擾；

translations.literal: Wen Fu also impeached him: 'Wu Dai is obstinate and self-willed; from Chengdu to the army he seized relay horses along the way and caused disturbances;'
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu impeached him in turn, charging that Wu Dai was stubborn and wilful, that from Chengdu to the front he had seized relay horses and caused disturbances along the road,

sentences.zh: 方攻巴朗拉，綠營兵驚退，五岱不能禁，詐言被創昏暈。

translations.literal: when they were attacking Balangla the Green Standard troops panicked and retreated, and Wu Dai could not restrain them, falsely claiming he had been wounded and had fainted.
translations.idiomatic: and that during the assault on Balangla the Green Standard troops had broken in panic while Wu Dai could not stop them, then falsely claimed he had been wounded and had fainted.

sentences.zh: 」上命豐升額、色布騰巴勒珠爾詣軍中按治。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Feng Sheng'e and Seboteng Baljur to proceed to the army to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Feng Sheng'e and Seboteng Baljur to go to the army and conduct an inquiry.

sentences.zh: 色布騰巴勒珠爾等疏言鞫五岱俱不承，請奪其職，留軍前自效，上責色布騰巴勒珠爾等所論列不得要領；

translations.literal: Seboteng Baljur and others memorialized that in questioning Wu Dai he denied everything and asked that his office be stripped while he remained at the front to redeem himself; the Emperor rebuked Seboteng Baljur and the others for failing to grasp the essentials in their findings;
translations.idiomatic: Seboteng Baljur and others reported that Wu Dai denied every charge under interrogation and asked that his post be removed while he stayed at the front to atone; the emperor criticized their report as missing the point,

sentences.zh: 复疏言溫福輕五岱，致起釁。

translations.literal: they again memorialized that Wen Fu had slighted Wu Dai and thereby provoked the quarrel.
translations.idiomatic: and they later memorialized again that Wen Fu had belittled Wu Dai and thus provoked the dispute.

sentences.zh: 溫福疏辨，謂五岱與色布騰巴勒珠爾朋比謀傾陷，上命色布騰巴勒珠爾等逮五岱詣熱河行在。

translations.literal: Wen Fu memorialized in rebuttal, saying Wu Dai had colluded with Seboteng Baljur to plot his ruin; the Emperor ordered Seboteng Baljur and the others to escort Wu Dai to the temporary palace at Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu replied that Wu Dai had banded with Seboteng Baljur to plot against him; the emperor then ordered Seboteng Baljur and the others to bring Wu Dai to the imperial camp at Rehe.

sentences.zh: 是時尚書福隆安奉使如四川，疏言五岱無奪驛馬及攻巴朗拉詐言被創事，色布騰巴勒珠爾亦未嘗袒五岱。

translations.literal: At that time Minister Fuk'ang-an was on mission to Sichuan and memorialized that Wu Dai had not seized relay horses nor falsely claimed wounds at Balangla, and that Seboteng Baljur had not shown partiality to Wu Dai.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the minister Fuk'ang'an, on mission to Sichuan, reported that Wu Dai had neither seized relay horses nor feigned wounds at Balangla, and that Seboteng Baljur had not favored him.

sentences.zh: 五岱至熱河，軍機大臣廷鞫，戍伊犁。

translations.literal: When Wu Dai reached Rehe, the Grand Council tried him in court and he was banished to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Dai arrived at Rehe, the Grand Council tried him in open court and he was exiled to Ili.

sentences.zh: 居數月，授藍翎侍衛，命從阿桂出南路聽差遣。

translations.literal: After several months he was appointed a blue-lance bodyguard and ordered to follow Agui on the southern route for assignment.
translations.idiomatic: Several months later he was made a blue-lance bodyguard and ordered to follow Agui on the southern route for service.

sentences.zh: 阿桂令率土兵赴美諾、明郭宗諸地，相機夾擊。

translations.literal: Agui ordered him to lead native troops to Meinuo, Mingguozong, and other places to strike in concert as opportunity allowed.
translations.idiomatic: Agui had him lead native levies toward Meinuo, Mingguozong, and other points to coordinate pincer attacks as circumstances allowed.

sentences.zh: 尋授頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed a first-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to first-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 木果木師潰，阿桂駐宜喜。

translations.literal: When the army was routed at Mugumu, Agui halted at Yixi.
translations.idiomatic: After the disaster at Mugumu, Agui held at Yixi.

sentences.zh: 命五岱為領隊侍衛，率貴州兵防後路。

translations.literal: Wu Dai was appointed a leading bodyguard and ordered to lead Guizhou troops to guard the rear.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dai was made a leading bodyguard and placed in command of Guizhou troops to secure the rear.

sentences.zh: 阿桂為定西將軍，授五岱正藍旗蒙古副都統，復為參贊大臣。

translations.literal: When Agui became Pacification Commissioner of the West, Wu Dai was appointed deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Plain Blue Banner and again made Grand Minister Consultant.
translations.idiomatic: When Agui became Pacification Commissioner of the West, Wu Dai was appointed deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Plain Blue Banner and again served as commissioner-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 從副將軍豐升額自丹壩進攻凱立葉，山峻，未深入。

translations.literal: Following Deputy General Feng Sheng'e he advanced from Danba against Kailiye; the mountains were steep and they did not penetrate deeply.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced from Danba against Kailiye with Deputy General Feng Sheng'e, but the mountains were steep and the column did not push far in.

sentences.zh: 上命豐升額佐阿桂合軍進，而以五岱駐凱立葉牽賊勢，賊屢來攻，屢擊敗之。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Feng Sheng'e to assist Agui in a combined advance, while Wu Dai was stationed at Kailiye to pin the rebels; the rebels repeatedly attacked and were repeatedly defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Feng Sheng'e to join Agui for a united advance, while Wu Dai was left at Kailiye to tie down rebel forces; the rebels attacked again and again and were beaten back each time.

sentences.zh: 五岱疏言軍中護軍校等缺，當擇應升人員，請上命。

translations.literal: Wu Dai memorialized that posts such as guard corporals in the army were vacant and that candidates for promotion should be chosen and submitted for imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dai memorialized that vacancies such as guard corporals in the army should be filled from men due for promotion, and asked the throne to decide.

sentences.zh: 上以參贊佐將軍治軍事，不得自專，責五岱非是。

translations.literal: The Emperor held that a consultant assisting a general must not act on his own authority and rebuked Wu Dai for being wrong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ruled that a commissioner assisting a general must not act on his own authority and rebuked Wu Dai.

sentences.zh: 阿桂、豐升額自日爾巴當噶進攻，五岱自凱立葉督兵夾擊，進逼勒烏圍。

translations.literal: Agui and Feng Sheng'e advanced from Ri'erbadangga, while Wu Dai directed troops from Kailiye in a pincer attack, pressing toward Lewuwei.
translations.idiomatic: Agui and Feng Sheng'e pushed forward from Ri'erbadangga while Wu Dai coordinated troops from Kailiye in a flanking drive toward Lewuwei.

sentences.zh: 阿桂令五岱移駐日則丫口。

translations.literal: Agui ordered Wu Dai to move his camp to Rizeyakou.
translations.idiomatic: Agui ordered Wu Dai to shift his station to Rizeyakou.

sentences.zh: 尋率兵協攻珠寨及噶朗噶各寨。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he led troops in a joint assault on Zhuzhai and the various stockades at Galangga.
translations.idiomatic: He soon led troops in combined attacks on Zhuzhai and the stockades at Galangga.

sentences.zh: 師攻勒烏圍，五岱率所部自東北入，合攻克之。

translations.literal: When the army attacked Lewuwei, Wu Dai led his detachment in from the northeast and they captured it together.
translations.idiomatic: During the assault on Lewuwei, Wu Dai brought his command in from the northeast and the position fell in a combined attack.

sentences.zh: 金川平，圖形紫光閣，列後五十功臣。

translations.literal: When the Jinchuan campaign was pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the last fifty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jinchuan pacification, his likeness was painted in the Hall of Purple Splendor as one of the last fifty honored officers.

sentences.zh: 出為塔爾巴哈台領隊大臣。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as leading minister at Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: He was later posted as leading minister at Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，自塔爾巴哈台詣京師，至蘭州，聞石峰堡回為亂，請從軍。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year, on his way from Tarbagatai to the capital, when he reached Lanzhou he heard that the Muslims of Shifengbao had risen in revolt and asked to join the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In year 49, traveling from Tarbagatai to the capital, he reached Lanzhou and heard that Muslims at Shifengbao had rebelled; he volunteered for the campaign.

sentences.zh: 上諭陝甘總督李侍堯，以五岱嘗從征金川，知軍事，令率兵進攻。

translations.literal: The Emperor instructed Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Li Shiyao that, as Wu Dai had campaigned in Jinchuan and understood military affairs, he was to be ordered to lead troops in the attack.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general Li Shiyao that Wu Dai, having served in the Jinchuan war and knowing military affairs, should be ordered to lead troops against the rebels.

sentences.zh: 侍堯令偕副都統永安、提督剛塔討賊，自馬家堡逐賊至鹿鹿山，大霧，駐軍數日，诇賊出後山，分軍捕治，命署固原提督。

translations.literal: Shiyao ordered him together with Deputy Lieutenant-General Yong'an and Provincial Commander Gangta to suppress the rebels; from Majiabao they drove the rebels to Lulu Mountain; in thick fog the army halted for several days, reconnoitered that the rebels had come out by the rear mountain, divided forces to round them up, and appointed him acting provincial commander of Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shiyao paired him with Deputy Lieutenant-General Yong'an and provincial commander Gangta; from Majiabao they pursued the rebels to Lulu Mountain, halted several days in heavy fog, learned the rebels had slipped out by the rear slope, split forces to intercept them, and gave Wu Dai acting command of the Guyuan garrison.

sentences.zh: 戰伏羌城外，殺賊三百餘，賊遁入山，遣兵搜捕，俘二百三十餘。

translations.literal: In battle outside Fuxiang city they killed more than three hundred rebels; the rebels fled into the mountains and troops were sent to hunt them down, capturing more than two hundred thirty.
translations.idiomatic: Outside Fuxiang they killed over three hundred rebels; the remainder fled into the hills, and search parties took more than two hundred thirty prisoners.

sentences.zh: 复逐賊至秦安縣，擬進攻底店。

translations.literal: They again pursued the rebels to Qin'an county and planned to advance against Didian.
translations.idiomatic: They pursued the rebels again to Qin'an county and prepared to attack Didian.

sentences.zh: 上令尚書福康安視師，五岱從，克底店；

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Minister Fuk'ang'an to take command of the army; Wu Dai followed him and captured Didian;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Minister Fuk'ang'an to supervise the campaign; Wu Dai served under him and took Didian;

sentences.zh: 進攻石峰堡，率兵搜捕黑矻塔、白楊嶺餘匪，毀床子灘禮拜寺，回亂平。

translations.literal: advancing against Shifengbao, he led troops to hunt down remnant bandits at Heitu Tower and Baiyang Ridge, destroyed the mosque at Chuangziwan, and the Muslim revolt was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: then advanced on Shifengbao, led sweeps against remnant rebels at Heitu Tower and Baiyang Ridge, destroyed the mosque at Chuangziwan, and the Muslim rising was put down.

sentences.zh: 上以五岱自塔爾巴哈台班滿還京，道聞回亂，自請從軍；

translations.literal: The Emperor noted that Wu Dai, on completing his term at Tarbagatai and returning to the capital, had heard of the Muslim revolt en route and volunteered for service;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor noted that Wu Dai, having finished his tour at Tarbagatai and been returning home, had heard of the rebellion on the road and asked to fight;

sentences.zh: 福康安未至，轉戰擊賊，奮勉，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: before Fuk'ang'an arrived he had fought in successive battles and exerted himself zealously, and was granted a hereditary office as Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: before Fuk'ang'an arrived he had already fought through several engagements with zeal, and was granted a hereditary commandant of cavalry.

sentences.zh: 尋擢鑲藍旗蒙古都統，充上書房總諳達，授領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was promoted to lieutenant-general of the Mongol Bordered Blue Banner, appointed chief instructor of the Upper Study, and made a chamberlain of the guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to lieutenant-general of the Mongol Bordered Blue Banner, made chief instructor of the Upper Study, and appointed chamberlain of the guard.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 五福，富察氏，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Wu Fu, of the Fuca clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Fu, of the Fuca clan, belonged to the Manchu Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 自世襲佐領累遷四川維州協副將，乾隆三十五年，小金川土司澤旺與鄂克什土司色達克拉構兵，五福請於總督阿爾泰，檄澤旺責使服罪。

translations.literal: From hereditary assistant commandant he rose to deputy commander of the Weizhou garrison in Sichuan; in the thirty-fifth year of Qianlong, the Lesser Jinchuan chieftain Tsewang and the Ekekesh chieftain Sedakla made war on each other; Wu Fu asked Governor-General Altai to issue a proclamation ordering Tsewang to submit and make amends.
translations.idiomatic: Rising from hereditary assistant commandant to deputy commander of the Weizhou garrison in Sichuan, in Qianlong 35 the Lesser Jinchuan chieftain Tsewang and the Ekekesh chieftain Sedakla clashed; Wu Fu asked governor-general Altai to summon Tsewang to submit.

sentences.zh: 澤旺子僧格桑尤桀驁，漸侵明正土司，乃令五福將五百人屯梭磨界樸頭，擢松潘鎮總兵，如美諾護糧道。

translations.literal: Tsewang's son Senggesan was especially fierce and arrogant and gradually encroached on the Mingzheng chieftain; he was then ordered to lead five hundred men to garrison Suomo at Jietou on the border, was promoted to commander of the Songpan garrison, and guarded the grain route at Meinuo.
translations.idiomatic: Tsewang's son Senggesan was especially violent and gradually encroached on the Mingzheng domain; Wu Fu was ordered to station five hundred men at Jietou on the Suomo border, was promoted commander of the Songpan garrison, and guarded the grain route at Meinuo.

sentences.zh: 小金川平，偕松茂道查禮按行邊徼屯練，及新附汗牛十四寨。

translations.literal: When Lesser Jinchuan was pacified, together with the Songmao intendant Zha Li he inspected border garrisons, militia training, and the fourteen newly submitted Han'niu stockades.
translations.idiomatic: After Lesser Jinchuan was pacified, he and Songmao intendant Zha Li inspected frontier garrisons, militia drill, and the fourteen newly submitted Han'niu stockades.

sentences.zh: 時僧格桑竄大金川，大金川土司索諾木與同為亂。

translations.literal: At that time Senggesan had fled into Greater Jinchuan, and the Greater Jinchuan chieftain Sonom joined him in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: By then Senggesan had fled into Greater Jinchuan, where chieftain Sonom joined him in revolt.

sentences.zh: 上慮兩酋逃往鄂羅克，命五福駐丹壩。

translations.literal: The Emperor feared both chiefs would escape toward the Gyarong, and ordered Wu Fu to hold Danba.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing both leaders would flee toward Gyarong, the emperor ordered Wu Fu to hold Danba.

sentences.zh: 丹壩，往鄂羅克道所必經也。

translations.literal: Danba lay on the road that must be taken to reach the Gyarong.
translations.idiomatic: Danba stood on the route any flight toward Gyarong would have to take.

sentences.zh: 賊襲攻底木達及大板昭。

translations.literal: The rebels attacked Dimuda and Daban Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels struck Dimuda and Daban Zhao.

sentences.zh: 師自登春入，五福自後路會攻。

translations.literal: The main army entered from Dengchun while Wu Fu joined the attack from the rear.
translations.idiomatic: The main force entered from Dengchun while Wu Fu coordinated from the rear.

sentences.zh: 尋請以副將西德布率兵還丹壩，而躬巡梭磨，土婦卓爾瑪初附，加以駕馭。

translations.literal: He soon asked that Deputy Commander Xidebu lead troops back to Danba while he himself toured Suomo to keep firm control over the newly submitted chieftainess Zhuo'erma.
translations.idiomatic: He soon requested that Deputy Commander Xidebu return with troops to Danba while he personally toured Suomo to keep the newly submitted chieftainess Zhuo'erma under control.

sentences.zh: 上命五福事畢仍還屯丹壩。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered that when Wu Fu had finished he was still to return and hold Danba.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered him to return to Danba once this duty was done.

sentences.zh: 五福旋自丹壩進攻穆爾津山，再戰陟其岡，毀賊碉，敗援賊。

translations.literal: Wu Fu then advanced from Danba against Mu'erjin Mountain, fought again to ascend its ridge, destroyed rebel blockhouses, and defeated relieving rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Fu advanced from Danba against Mu'erjin Mountain, fought his way onto the ridge, destroyed rebel forts, and beat back relief columns.

sentences.zh: 師進攻，五福以三百六十人為應，令官兵作攻撲狀綴賊，土兵伏作固頂水卡旁。

translations.literal: When the army attacked, Wu Fu with three hundred sixty men acted as support, ordering regular troops to feign assaults to pin the rebels while native soldiers lay in ambush beside the Guding Shui stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the general assault Wu Fu took three hundred sixty men as reserve: regulars feigned attacks to fix the rebels while native troops lay in wait by the Guding Shui stockade.

sentences.zh: 賊至，伏發，殪其頭人，遂進攻山半賊碉，五福督兵斫碉門殺賊。

translations.literal: When the rebels came, the ambush struck and killed their leader; they then advanced against the mid-mountain blockhouse, and Wu Fu supervised troops in chopping down the gate and killing rebels.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels arrived the ambush killed their leader; they then stormed the mid-slope blockhouse, and Wu Fu led men in breaking the gate and slaughtering the garrison.

sentences.zh: 將軍阿桂等師克格魯克古丫口，將達丹壩，五福隔山見師至，即督兵攻普籠、瑪讓諸碉，同時盡毀，於作固頂以下傍水設營卡。

translations.literal: When Generals Agui and others took the Gelukeguyakou pass and were nearing Danba, Wu Fu saw the main army across the mountain and immediately directed troops against the Pulon and Marang blockhouses, destroying them all at once and establishing camps and stockades along the water below Gudingding.
translations.idiomatic: When Generals Agui and others took Gelukeguyakou and neared Danba, Wu Fu saw the main column across the ridge and at once attacked the Pulon and Marang forts, destroying them together and posting camps along the stream below Gudingding.

sentences.zh: 師進攻勒烏圍，五福自陡烏當噶夾攻，斃賊甚眾，進攻榮噶爾博，毀賊碉一。

translations.literal: When the army attacked Lewuwei, Wu Fu attacked from Dou'udangga in concert, killed many rebels, advanced on Rongga'erbo, and destroyed one blockhouse.
translations.idiomatic: In the assault on Lewuwei, Wu Fu struck from Dou'udangga in coordination, killed large numbers of rebels, advanced on Rongga'erbo, and destroyed one fort.

sentences.zh: 師屯巴克圖仰木山巔，五福克薩木卡爾山下諸碉卡，與大軍會。

translations.literal: The army encamped on the crest of Baketu Yangmu Mountain; Wu Fu captured the blockhouses and stockades below Samuka'er Mountain and joined the main force.
translations.idiomatic: The main army camped on Baketu Yangmu summit; Wu Fu took the forts below Samuka'er Mountain and linked up with the grand army.

sentences.zh: 自達烏達圍進攻，五福同總兵常祿保等為應。

translations.literal: Advancing from Dawudaiwei, Wu Fu with Commander Chang Lubao and others served as support.
translations.idiomatic: Moving up from Dawudaiwei, Wu Fu with commander Chang Lubao and others acted as the supporting wing.

sentences.zh: 既克黃草坪，賊自山後出，五福夾擊敗之。

translations.literal: After Huangcaoping was taken, rebels came out from behind the mountain and Wu Fu defeated them in a pincer.
translations.idiomatic: Once Huangcaoping fell, rebels sallied from behind the ridge and Wu Fu crushed them in a flanking action.

sentences.zh: 師自奔布魯木進攻，為三隊，五福與副都統烏什哈達率第三隊，圍賊碉。

translations.literal: When the army advanced from Benbulumu in three columns, Wu Fu with Deputy Lieutenant-General Wu Shenhada led the third column and surrounded the rebel blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: As the army advanced from Benbulumu in three columns, Wu Fu and Deputy Lieutenant-General Wu Shenhada led the third column and invested the rebel forts.

sentences.zh: 賊越碉竄，與第一、二隊合，至西里正寨，賊潰遁。

translations.literal: The rebels fled over the blockhouses and joined the first and second columns; reaching Xilizheng stockade, the rebels broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels scrambled over the forts and merged with the first and second columns; at Xilizheng stockade the enemy collapsed and ran.

sentences.zh: 分攻瓦爾佔、舍勒固租魯，夜移砲轟毀之。

translations.literal: They divided forces to attack Wa'erzhan and Sheleguzulu, and by night moved artillery to bombard and destroy them.
translations.idiomatic: Forces split to take Wa'erzhan and Sheleguzulu, moving guns up by night to smash them.

sentences.zh: 進攻薩爾歪賊寨，復為三隊，五福與都統海蘭察自中路進，賊棄寨竄；

translations.literal: Attacking the Sa'erwai rebel stockade, they again formed three columns; Wu Fu with Lieutenant-General Hailanqa advanced from the center and the rebels abandoned the stockade and fled;
translations.idiomatic: In the attack on Sa'erwai stockade they again deployed three columns; Wu Fu and Lieutenant-General Hailanqa took the center, and the rebels abandoned the position;

sentences.zh: 复繞出寨後，殲賊甚眾，賊寨皆下。

translations.literal: they again circled behind the stockade and annihilated very many rebels, and all the rebel stockades fell.
translations.idiomatic: then swung behind the stockade and killed a great many; every rebel strongpoint in the sector fell.

sentences.zh: 金川平，圖形紫光閣，列後五十功臣。

translations.literal: When the Jinchuan campaign was pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the last fifty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinchuan was pacified, his likeness joined the last fifty portraits in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 師既還，以兩金川地勢寥闊，命五福將三千人屯美諾。

translations.literal: After the army withdrew, because the two Jinchuan regions were vast in terrain, Wu Fu was ordered to station three thousand men at Meinuo.
translations.idiomatic: When the army withdrew, the court ordered Wu Fu to garrison three thousand men at Meinuo because the two Jinchuan territories were so extensive.

sentences.zh: 尋擢廣西提督。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was promoted to provincial commander of Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made provincial commander of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 海祿，齊普齊特氏，蒙古正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Hai Lu, of the Qipqit clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lu, of the Qipqit clan, was a Mongol of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 以前鋒從征伊犁，定邊右副將軍兆惠屯濟爾哈朗，副將軍富德攻葉爾羌，攻伊西洱庫爾淖爾，海祿皆在軍中，賜花翎，並號噶卜什海巴圖魯。

translations.literal: As a vanguard he followed the campaign in Ili; when Pacification Commissioner of the Border Right Zhaohui encamped at Jierhalang and Deputy General Fude attacked Yarkand and Lake Yashilkul, Hai Lu was in the army, was granted the peacock feather, and also received the title Gabushiha Batüru.
translations.idiomatic: As a vanguard he served in the Ili campaign; when Zhaohui encamped at Jierhalang and Fude attacked Yarkand and Lake Yashilkul, Hai Lu was present, received the peacock feather, and the title Gabushiha Batüru.

sentences.zh: 又以邊功，擢二等侍衛。

translations.literal: For frontier merit he was again promoted to second-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Further frontier service won him promotion to second-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 溫福討金川，海祿將四百人攻斑斕山及斯當安，攻日耳、東瑪、美美諸寨，及固卜濟山梁，又克路頂宗、喀木色爾諸寨，破明郭宗溝內碉卡。

translations.literal: When Wen Fu campaigned against Jinchuan, Hai Lu led four hundred men to attack Banlanshan and Sidang'an, attacked the stockades of Ri'er, Dongma, Meimei, and others, and Gubujishan Ridge, and also captured Ludingzong, Kamuse'er, and other stockades, breaking the blockhouses and stockades within Mingguozong ravine.
translations.idiomatic: In Wen Fu's Jinchuan campaign Hai Lu led four hundred men against Banlanshan and Sidang'an, took stockades at Ri'er, Dongma, Meimei, and elsewhere, Gubujishan Ridge, and captured Ludingzong, Kamuse'er, and other positions, clearing blockhouses inside Mingguozong gorge.

sentences.zh: 自前鋒參領攝陝西固原鎮總兵。

translations.literal: From acting vanguard colonel he was appointed in charge as commander of the Guyuan garrison in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: From acting vanguard colonel he was placed in command of the Guyuan garrison in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 溫福師敗績，海祿自美諾退巴朗拉，定西將軍阿桂論劾，當奪職，命寬之。

translations.literal: When Wen Fu's army suffered defeat, Hai Lu retreated from Meinuo to Balangla; Pacification Commissioner Agui memorialized for punishment and his office should have been stripped, but the order was lenient.
translations.idiomatic: After Wen Fu's defeat Hai Lu fell back from Meinuo to Balangla; Agui called for his dismissal, but the throne was lenient.

sentences.zh: 師自資哩南山入，得阿喀木雅山上碉一。

translations.literal: The army entered from Zili Nanshan and took one blockhouse on Akemuya Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The army entered from Zili Nanshan and seized a blockhouse on Akemuya Mountain.

sentences.zh: 至路頂宗，山陡峻，夜半潛入賊壘，殲賊三十餘，墜崖死者相枕藉，遂拔路頂宗，即督兵進攻明郭宗，克之。

translations.literal: Reaching Ludingzong, where the mountain was steep and precipitous, at midnight they stole into the rebel camp, killed more than thirty rebels, and those who fell from the cliffs lay piled one on another; they then took Ludingzong and immediately directed troops to attack Mingguozong and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: At Ludingzong, where cliffs were sheer, they slipped into the rebel camp at midnight, killed more than thirty men, and bodies piled at the foot of the cliffs; Ludingzong fell, and he pressed on to Mingguozong and took it.

sentences.zh: 直抵美諾，賊驚潰，獲大砲十餘、米糧百餘石，擢固原鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Pressing straight to Meinuo, the rebels were startled and scattered; they captured more than ten large cannon and over a hundred piculs of grain and were promoted to commander of the Guyuan garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Driving straight to Meinuo they routed the terrified rebels, captured more than ten heavy guns and over a hundred piculs of grain, and Hai Lu was confirmed as Guyuan commander.

sentences.zh: 從阿桂自薩爾赤鄂羅山攻克登古碉卡。

translations.literal: Following Agui he took the Denggu blockhouse and stockade from Sa'erchie'eluo Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Agui in taking the Denggu stockade from Sa'erchie'eluo Mountain.

sentences.zh: 復自喇穆喇穆迤西進，得石卡一。

translations.literal: Advancing again west from Lamulamu, they took one stone stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Pushing west from Lamulamu they seized a stone stockade.

sentences.zh: 攻得斯東寨、色淜普、喇穆喇穆山梁，屯日則丫口要路。

translations.literal: They attacked Desidong stockade, Seqinpu, and Lamulamu Ridge, and held the vital route at Rizeyakou.
translations.idiomatic: They attacked Desidong, Seqinpu, and Lamulamu Ridge and held the key pass at Rizeyakou.

sentences.zh: 又攻該布達什諾木城，連克碉寨。

translations.literal: They again attacked the Nuomucheng of Gaibudashi and captured blockhouses and stockades in succession.
translations.idiomatic: They stormed Gaibudashi's Nuomucheng and took a chain of forts and stockades.

sentences.zh: 攻遜克爾宗，賊出伏兵，擊之潰。

translations.literal: Attacking Xunke'erzong, the rebels set an ambush and were routed.
translations.idiomatic: At Xunke'erzong the rebels ambushed and were driven off.

sentences.zh: 旋偕副都統富興進至達爾沙朗，克大碉五，並克伊格爾瑪迪等碉卡。

translations.literal: Soon, together with Deputy Lieutenant-General Fuxing, he advanced to Da'ershalang and took five large blockhouses, and also captured the blockhouses and stockades of Yige'ermadi and others.
translations.idiomatic: He soon advanced with Deputy Lieutenant-General Fuxing to Da'ershalang, took five large forts, and captured Yige'ermadi and other positions.

sentences.zh: 再進，偕副都統烏什哈達奪羅卜克鄂博溝內碉寨，攻克格魯克古山梁。

translations.literal: Advancing again, together with Deputy Lieutenant-General Wu Shenhada he seized blockhouses and stockades within Luoboke'ebo ravine and captured Gelukegu Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing on with Wu Shenhada he cleared forts in Luoboke'ebo gorge and took Gelukegu Ridge.

sentences.zh: 再進攻康薩爾，督兵躍壕入，賊竄。

translations.literal: Advancing again to attack Kangsa'er, he directed troops to leap the moat and enter; the rebels fled.
translations.idiomatic: In a further advance on Kangsa'er he led men over the ditch into the works; the rebels fled.

sentences.zh: 再進，攻克勒吉爾博山梁，乘勝沿河擊賊，大破之。

translations.literal: Advancing again, he captured Leji'erbo Ridge and, pressing his advantage along the river, routed the rebels in a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: He next took Leji'erbo Ridge and, following the river, inflicted a major rout.

sentences.zh: 師攻木思工噶克丫口，海祿以兵應，殲賊甚眾。

translations.literal: When the army attacked the Musigonggake pass, Hai Lu supported with troops and annihilated very many rebels.
translations.idiomatic: In the assault on Musigonggake pass Hai Lu supported the attack and killed a great many rebels.

sentences.zh: 攻克邁過爾山梁，复偕烏什哈達攻丫口左木城、石碉，拔之。

translations.literal: He captured Maiguo'er Ridge and again with Wu Shenhada attacked the wooden fort and stone blockhouse to the left of the pass and took them.
translations.idiomatic: He took Maiguo'er Ridge and with Wu Shenhada stormed the wooden fort and stone tower left of the pass.

sentences.zh: 又自舍圖枉卡分攻巴佔，攀藤扶石，自山腰斜上，遂奪據毗色爾，進攻章噶大碉，克之，並奪木城一。

translations.literal: Again from Shetuwang stockade he divided forces to attack Bazhan; climbing vines and bracing on rocks, they ascended obliquely from the mountainside and seized Pise'er, advanced to attack the great blockhouse at Zhangga, captured it, and also took one wooden fort.
translations.idiomatic: From Shetuwang stockade he split forces against Bazhan; men climbed by vines along the slope, seized Pise'er, stormed the great fort at Zhangga, and took a wooden fort as well.

sentences.zh: 偕襄陽鎮總兵官達色攻黃草坪，佔其地。

translations.literal: Together with Xiangyang garrison commander Guan Da Se he attacked Huangcaoping and occupied the ground.
translations.idiomatic: With Xiangyang commander Guan Da Se he attacked Huangcaoping and held the position.

sentences.zh: 移直隸天津鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was transferred to commander of the Tianjin garrison in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to commander of the Tianjin garrison in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 旋率土兵奪兜窩碉卡，复奪取莎羅奔甲爾瓦沃雜爾所居之拉布咱佔。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he led native troops to seize the Douwo blockhouse and stockade, and again captured Labuzhan, where the Zhaowa chieftain of the Shabron tribe dwelt.
translations.idiomatic: He soon led native troops to take Douwo stockade and also Labuzhan, seat of the Shabron Zhaowa chieftain.

sentences.zh: 又偕副都統書麟等攻則朗噶克，焚噶爾噶木、勒烏、果木得克、聶烏諸賊寨。

translations.literal: Again, together with Deputy Lieutenant-General Shu Lin and others, he attacked Zelangake and burned the rebel stockades at Ga'ergamu, Lewu, Guomudeke, Nie'wu, and others.
translations.idiomatic: With Deputy Lieutenant-General Shu Lin and others he attacked Zelangake and burned rebel strongholds at Ga'ergamu, Lewu, Guomudeke, Nie'wu, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 金川平，圖形紫光閣，賜騎都尉世職，擢雲南提督。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor; he was granted a hereditary office as Commandant of Cavalry and promoted to provincial commander of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jinchuan pacification his likeness was painted in the Hall of Purple Splendor; he received a hereditary commandant of cavalry and was made Yunnan provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，入覲。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year he came to court for an audience.
translations.idiomatic: In year 46 he presented himself at court.

sentences.zh: 至湖南，聞薩拉爾回蘇四十三叛，請從軍。

translations.literal: When he reached Hunan he heard that the Salaer Muslim Su Sishi had rebelled and asked to join the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Hunan, he learned that the Salaer Muslim Su Sishi had risen in revolt and volunteered for service.

sentences.zh: 賊佔華林山，海祿從海蘭察攻之，多所斬獲。

translations.literal: The rebels held Hualin Mountain; Hai Lu followed Hailanqa in the attack and killed or captured many.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels held Hualin Mountain; Hai Lu campaigned under Hailanqa and took many heads and prisoners.

sentences.zh: 旋進至華林寺，毀賊巢，殲焉。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he advanced to Hualin Temple, destroyed the rebel nest, and annihilated them.
translations.idiomatic: He soon pushed to Hualin Temple, destroyed the rebel base, and wiped them out.

sentences.zh: 授烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: He was appointed lieutenant-general at Urumqi.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed commandant at Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 海祿刻覈吏事。

translations.literal: Hai Lu was severe and exacting in administrative matters.
translations.idiomatic: Hai Lu ran administration with harsh exactitude.

sentences.zh: 在邊，禁古城迤北瑚圖斯金廠。

translations.literal: On the frontier he prohibited the Hutusi gold mines north of the old city.
translations.idiomatic: On the border he banned the Hutusi gold mines north of the old town.

sentences.zh: 重定新疆屯田徵租功過，視舊例為苛。

translations.literal: He revised rewards and penalties for frontier garrison farming rents, making them harsher than the old regulations.
translations.idiomatic: He reset merit-and-penalty rules for Xinjiang garrison farming rents, tightening them beyond precedent.

sentences.zh: 追論文武吏士剝下營私狀，領隊大臣圖思義、提督彭廷棟以下皆坐譴。

translations.literal: He pursued charges that civil and military officers and soldiers had squeezed subordinates for private gain; the leading minister Tusi Yi, Provincial Commander Peng Tingdong, and others below them were all punished.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating graft by officers and men who preyed on subordinates, he brought down Leading Minister Tusi Yi, Commander Peng Tingdong, and many others.

sentences.zh: 又請裁汰經費，視內地編保甲；

translations.literal: He also asked to cut expenses and organize baojia militia as in the interior;
translations.idiomatic: He also proposed budget cuts and baojia-style local defense as in China proper;

sentences.zh: 台灣民坐械鬥戍邊，入烏魯木齊鐵廠輸作，予巴里坤諸地戍兵為奴；

translations.literal: Taiwan civilians sentenced for armed brawls were exiled to the frontier and sent to ironworks at Urumqi as laborers, to be slaves to garrison troops at Barkul and other posts;
translations.idiomatic: Taiwan convicts from clan fights were sent to frontier ironworks at Urumqi as labor slaves for garrisons at Barkul and elsewhere;

sentences.zh: 皆議行。

translations.literal: all these proposals were approved.
translations.idiomatic: all were approved.

sentences.zh: 复疏請自哈密至精河設台車三百五十，烏魯木齊設台車一百五十，定值視僱商車減三之二。

translations.literal: He again memorialized to establish three hundred fifty relay carts from Hami to Jinghe and one hundred fifty at Urumqi, fixing rates two-thirds below hired merchant carts.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked for three hundred fifty relay carts from Hami to Jinghe and one hundred fifty at Urumqi, with fees set two-thirds below commercial haulage.

sentences.zh: 烏什辦事大臣綽克托、塔爾巴哈台辦事大臣惠齡、陝甘總督福康安皆言車值過薄，福康安並力陳設台車不若僱商車便。

translations.literal: The Ush Commissioner Chuoketuo, the Tarbagatai Commissioner Huling, and Shaanxi-Gansu Governor-General Fuk'ang'an all said cart fees were too low; Fuk'ang'an also argued forcefully that relay carts were less convenient than hired merchant carts.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioners Chuoketuo at Ush and Huling at Tarbagatai and Governor-General Fuk'ang'an all protested that cart rates were too cheap; Fuk'ang'an insisted relay carts were inferior to hired commercial transport.

sentences.zh: 上為罷海祿議，造台車糜帑，令責償。

translations.literal: The Emperor set aside Hai Lu's proposal; building relay carts wasted treasury funds, and he was ordered to make restitution.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rejected Hai Lu's plan, ruled that building relay carts wasted state funds, and ordered him to repay the cost.

sentences.zh: 伊犁將軍伊勒圖又疏請罷海祿所議屯田徵租功過及戍邊入鐵廠例，左授伊犁額魯特領大臣。

translations.literal: Ili General Yiletü also memorialized to abolish Hai Lu's rules on garrison-farming rents and on sending exiles to ironworks; Hai Lu was demoted to Erlut leading minister at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: General Yiletü of Ili also asked to repeal Hai Lu's farming-rent and ironworks policies; Hai Lu was demoted to Erlut leading minister at Ili.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，劾將軍奎林毀佛像，辱職官，折罪人手足擲水中，得遣戍罪人贓，又於哈薩克以羊易布，私其羨金。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year he impeached General Kuilin for destroying Buddha images, insulting officials, breaking the limbs of condemned men and throwing them into water, taking bribes from exiles he had sent away, and at the Kazakh border trading sheep for cloth while pocketing the surplus gold.
translations.idiomatic: In year 53 he impeached General Kuilin for smashing Buddha images, humiliating officials, maiming convicts and casting them into rivers, taking bribes from banished criminals, and at the Kazakh frontier bartering sheep for cloth while keeping the extra gold.

sentences.zh: 上奪奎林職，令海祿並詣京師，命諸皇子、軍機大臣會刑部廷鞫。

translations.literal: The Emperor stripped Kuilin of his office and ordered Hai Lu to come to the capital as well; he commanded the princes and Grand Council to join the Ministry of Punishments in a court trial.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor removed Kuilin and summoned Hai Lu to the capital; princes and the Grand Council were ordered to try both men with the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 奎林承毀佛像、殺罪人，餘事皆無據。

translations.literal: Kuilin admitted destroying Buddha images and killing convicts; the other charges were unsupported.
translations.idiomatic: Kuilin confessed to destroying images and killing prisoners; the rest lacked proof.

sentences.zh: 上命並奪海祿職，在上虞備用處拜唐阿上效力行走。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Hai Lu's office stripped as well and assigned him to serve at the reserve post of Baitang'a in Shangyu.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor stripped Hai Lu too and sent him to serve at the reserve post of Baitang'a in Shangyu.

sentences.zh: 尋授藍翎侍衛，累遷至福建陸路提督。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed a blue-lance bodyguard and rose in succession to provincial commander of Fujian infantry.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made a blue-lance bodyguard and eventually became Fujian infantry commander.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 成德，鈕祜祿氏，滿洲正紅旗人。

translations.literal: Cheng De, of the Niuhuru clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng De, of the Niuhuru clan, belonged to the Manchu Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 初入健銳營充前鋒。

translations.literal: At first he entered the Vanguard Camp as a vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: He first joined the Vanguard Camp as a front-line soldier.

sentences.zh: 從征準噶爾、葉爾羌，俱有功。

translations.literal: He followed campaigns against the Dzungars and at Yarkand, both with merit.
translations.idiomatic: He served in the Dzungar and Yarkand campaigns with distinction.

sentences.zh: 徵緬甸，從將軍明瑞自錫箔進兵，攻賊舊小蒲坡，中槍傷，戰猛拜、天生橋、猛城諸地。

translations.literal: In the Burma campaign he followed General Mingrui advancing from Xibo, attacked the rebel position at Jiuxiaopopo, was wounded by gunfire, and fought at Mengbai, Tiansheng Bridge, Mengcheng, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: In the Burma war he followed General Mingrui from Xibo, stormed Jiuxiaopopo, was shot, and fought at Mengbai, Tiansheng Bridge, Mengcheng, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 從副將軍阿里袞攻頓拐，毀其寨。

translations.literal: Following Deputy General Aligün he attacked Dunguai and destroyed its stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Under Deputy General Aligün he took Dunguai and destroyed its fort.

sentences.zh: 從經略大學士傅恆渡戛鳩江，自猛拱、猛養進兵，敗賊於新街。

translations.literal: Following Grand Secretary and Pacification Commissioner Fu Heng he crossed the Gajiang River and advanced from Menggong and Mengyang, defeating rebels at Xinjie.
translations.idiomatic: With Grand Secretary Fu Heng he crossed the Gajiang and advanced from Menggong and Mengyang, beating the enemy at Xinjie.

sentences.zh: 定邊右副將軍溫福徵小金川，成德從攻斯當安，裹創力戰，進攻巴朗拉。

translations.literal: When Pacification Commissioner of the Border Right Wen Fu campaigned against Lesser Jinchuan, Cheng De followed the attack on Sidang'an, fought wrapped in bandages, and advanced against Balangla.
translations.idiomatic: In Wen Fu's Lesser Jinchuan campaign Cheng De fought at Sidang'an despite wounds, then pressed on to Balangla.

sentences.zh: 再進，克資哩、古布濟、八角寨諸地，復被創；

translations.literal: Advancing again, he captured Zili, Gubuji, Bajiao stockade, and other places, and was wounded again;
translations.idiomatic: In further advances he took Zili, Gubuji, Bajiao stockade, and other points, and was wounded again;

sentences.zh: 自空卡、昔嶺進兵，屢捷，累遷四川川北鎮總兵。

translations.literal: from Kongka and Xiling he advanced repeatedly with victory and was promoted in succession to commander of the Chuandao garrison in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Pushing from Kongka and Xiling he won repeated fights and rose to commander of the Chuandao garrison in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 木果木大營陷，溫福死之，成德時將別軍駐美諾，亦陷於賊，命奪官，仍留任。

translations.literal: When the great camp at Mugumu fell and Wen Fu died, Cheng De was then commanding a separate army at Meinuo and also fell to the rebels; his office was ordered stripped but he was kept on duty.
translations.idiomatic: When the Mugumu headquarters collapsed and Wen Fu was killed, Cheng De's separate force at Meinuo was overrun too; he was stripped of rank but kept in post.

sentences.zh: 將軍阿桂令自南山攻取阿喀木雅，會領隊大臣額森特、總兵海祿三道並進，擊東溝賊碉，殲賊甚眾。

translations.literal: General Agui ordered him to attack Akemuya from the southern mountains; together with Leading Minister Esente and Commander Hai Lu in three columns they advanced, assaulted blockhouses in East Ravine, and killed very many rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Agui ordered him to take Akemuya from the south; with Esente and Hai Lu in three columns they stormed East Ravine forts and killed a great many rebels.

sentences.zh: 路頂宗、明郭宗諸營卡皆下，复美諾，賜黑狐冠。

translations.literal: Stockades at Ludingzong, Mingguozong, and elsewhere all fell, Meinuo was recovered, and he was granted a black fox fur crown.
translations.idiomatic: Ludingzong, Mingguozong, and other posts fell, Meinuo was retaken, and he received a black fox fur crown.

sentences.zh: 小金川平，复官。

translations.literal: When Lesser Jinchuan was pacified, his office was restored.
translations.idiomatic: After Lesser Jinchuan was pacified his rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 師自谷噶入大金川，抵羅博瓦山，成德偕總兵特成額等分兵綴賊。

translations.literal: The army entered Greater Jinchuan from Guga and reached Luobowa Mountain; Cheng De with Commander Te Cheng'e and others divided forces to pin the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The army entered Greater Jinchuan from Guga to Luobowa Mountain; Cheng De and Commander Te Cheng'e split forces to fix the enemy.

sentences.zh: 復會克色淜普山，奪堅碉數十。

translations.literal: They again joined in taking Seqinpu Ridge and seized several dozen strong blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: They jointly took Seqinpu Ridge and dozens of stubborn forts.

sentences.zh: 進攻喇穆喇穆東面山碉，賊分兩路襲師後，擊敗之。

translations.literal: Attacking blockhouses on the east face of Lamulamu, rebels split into two columns to strike the army's rear and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Assaulting Lamulamu's eastern forts, rebels hit the rear in two columns and were beaten off.

sentences.zh: 偕散秩大臣普爾普等奪石碉四，又偕總兵官達色攻克該布達什諾木城，會內大臣海蘭察進圍遜克爾宗，賜號賽尚阿巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Together with Minister without Rank Pu'erpu and others he seized four stone blockhouses; again with Commander Guan Da Se he captured Gaibudashi's Nuomucheng; joining Inner Minister Hailanqa he invested Xunke'erzong and was granted the title Saishang'a Batüru.
translations.idiomatic: With Pu'erpu he took four stone forts; with Guan Da Se he captured Gaibudashi's Nuomucheng; with Hailanqa he besieged Xunke'erzong and received the title Saishang'a Batüru.

sentences.zh: 進攻甲爾納寨，圍急，賊潛以皮船渡，成德擊破之。

translations.literal: Attacking Jia'erna stockade under tight siege, rebels secretly crossed by leather boats; Cheng De broke them.
translations.idiomatic: Besieging Jia'erna, rebels tried to escape by skin boats; Cheng De smashed the attempt.

sentences.zh: 賊據赤布寨，其北為得思古寨，循溝下有噶朗噶、噶爾噶諸寺，碉寨繁密。

translations.literal: The rebels held Chibu stockade; north of it was Desigu stockade; along the ravine below were the Galangga and Ga'erga monasteries, with dense blockhouses and stockades.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels held Chibu; Desigu lay to the north; down the gorge stood Galangga and Ga'erga temples amid thick forts and stockades.

sentences.zh: 師循溝進，破最東水碉。

translations.literal: The army advanced along the ravine and broke the easternmost water blockhouse.
translations.idiomatic: The army followed the gorge and smashed the easternmost river fort.

sentences.zh: 成德乘勝奪大碉五、木城二，直抵瀕河噶爾丹寺，賊奔潰，師克舍圖枉卡。

translations.literal: Cheng De pressed the advantage, seized five large blockhouses and two wooden forts, reached the riverside Ga'erdan Temple, the rebels fled in rout, and the army took Shetuwang stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng De exploited the victory, took five great forts and two wooden citadels, drove to Ga'erdan Temple on the river, routed the enemy, and the army seized Shetuwang stockade.

sentences.zh: 成德潛師至日則丫口，與游擊普吉保上下合擊，破石碉八、木城四，遂克遜克爾宗，賊退勒烏圍，復進，會師破之。

translations.literal: Cheng De secretly led troops to Rizeyakou and, coordinating with Guerrilla Commander Puji Bao above and below, broke eight stone blockhouses and four wooden forts, then took Xunke'erzong; the rebels retreated to Lewuwei, advanced again, and the armies together broke it.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng De stole a march to Rizeyakou and, with Puji Bao coordinating from above and below, smashed eight stone forts and four wooden works, took Xunke'erzong, drove the enemy to Lewuwei, and joined the main force in its fall.

sentences.zh: 進克甘都瓦爾、黃草坪等處，遂克噶拉依。

translations.literal: Advancing they captured Ganduwa'er, Huangcaoping, and other places, and finally took Galayi.
translations.idiomatic: They next took Ganduwa'er, Huangcaoping, and other positions, and at last Galayi.

sentences.zh: 金川平，圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first fifty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinchuan was pacified his likeness was painted among the first fifty honorees in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 署四川提督。

translations.literal: He served as acting provincial commander of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He acted as Sichuan provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 三暗巴番渠安錯煽亂，督兵捕治，命真除。

translations.literal: The chieftain An Cuo of the San'anba Fan incited rebellion; he led troops to suppress it and was confirmed in office.
translations.idiomatic: When San'anba chieftain An Cuo stirred revolt he led troops to crush it and was confirmed in post.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，廓爾喀侵後藏，命成德為參贊大臣，督兵偕總督鄂輝、駐藏大臣侍郎巴忠會剿。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year the Gurkhas invaded rear Tibet; Cheng De was appointed Grand Minister Consultant to lead troops with Governor E Hui and the resident minister Vice President Ba Zhong in joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In year 53 Gurkhas invaded rear Tibet; Cheng De was made commissioner-in-chief to campaign with Governor E Hui and resident minister Ba Zhong.

sentences.zh: 巴忠授意噶布倫丹津旺珠爾與廓爾喀議歲費、還侵地，成德爭不獲，即以此議入奏。

translations.literal: Ba Zhong instructed the Kashag officer Dain Wangzhu'er to negotiate annual payments and return of invaded territory with the Gurkhas; Cheng De objected in vain and memorialized the agreement as settled.
translations.idiomatic: Ba Zhong had Kashag officer Dain Wangzhu'er negotiate yearly tribute and return of land with the Gurkhas; Cheng De protested without success and reported the deal.

sentences.zh: 師還，授成都將軍。

translations.literal: When the army withdrew he was appointed General of Chengdu.
translations.idiomatic: After the withdrawal he became General of Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 後藏不如約，靳歲費不與，廓爾喀復來犯，巴忠自經死。

translations.literal: Rear Tibet failed to keep the agreement and withheld the annual payment; the Gurkhas invaded again and Ba Zhong hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Rear Tibet broke the pact and withheld tribute; the Gurkhas attacked again and Ba Zhong committed suicide.

sentences.zh: 上命鄂輝、成德督兵定藏自贖；

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered E Hui and Cheng De to lead troops to pacify Tibet and redeem themselves;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered E Hui and Cheng De to pacify Tibet and redeem their errors;

sentences.zh: 復以濡滯失機，奪將軍，予副都統銜，以領隊大臣屬將軍福康安調遣。

translations.literal: again, for sluggishness and missing opportunities, Cheng De was stripped of his generalship and given the rank of deputy lieutenant-general, serving as leading minister under General Fuk'ang'an.
translations.idiomatic: for dilatoriness he lost the generalship, received deputy lieutenant-general rank, and served as leading minister under Fuk'ang'an.

sentences.zh: 攻聶拉木，與穆克登阿夜督兵進。

translations.literal: Attacking Nyalam, he and Mukedeng'a directed night advances.
translations.idiomatic: At Nyalam he and Mukedeng'a led night assaults.

sentences.zh: 成德攻寨西北，穆克登阿出西南，擲火彈殺賊，破寨，盡殲守寨賊，無一得脫者。

translations.literal: Cheng De attacked the northwest of the stockade, Mukedeng'a the southwest; they threw fire bombs, killed rebels, broke the stockade, and annihilated the garrison without a single escape.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng De struck the northwest, Mukedeng'a the southwest; fire bombs broke the fort and every defender was killed.

sentences.zh: 福康安自濟嚨進兵，令成德等分道進屯德親鼎山，克敵卡，自俄瑪措山進，迭克果果薩喇嘛寺，乘夜取札木鐵索橋。

translations.literal: Fuk'ang'an advanced from Jilong and ordered Cheng De and others to advance by separate routes and encamp at Deqinding Mountain, take enemy stockades, advance from E'macuo Mountain, capture Guoguo Sa Lama Temple in succession, and seize the iron-chain bridge at Zhamu by night.
translations.idiomatic: Fuk'ang'an marched from Jilong; Cheng De's columns took Deqinding Mountain, enemy posts, Guoguo Sa Lama Temple, and by night the iron-chain bridge at Zhamu.

sentences.zh: 又自江各波邁山梁趨隴岡，與彥吉保會；

translations.literal: Again from Jianggebo Mai Ridge he hastened to Longgang and joined Yan Jibao;
translations.idiomatic: From Jianggebo Mai Ridge he hurried to Longgang and met Yan Jibao;

sentences.zh: 逐賊至利底，與福康安師會，所向克捷。

translations.literal: pursuing rebels to Lidi he joined Fuk'ang'an's army and won wherever they went.
translations.idiomatic: pursuing the enemy to Lidi he united with Fuk'ang'an and swept all before them.

sentences.zh: 廓爾喀乞降，師還，命成德以副都統銜充駐藏幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: The Gurkhas begged surrender; when the army withdrew Cheng De was ordered to serve as assistant resident minister in Tibet with the rank of deputy lieutenant-general.
translations.idiomatic: The Gurkhas sued for peace; on withdrawal Cheng De was made assistant resident minister in Tibet.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣，前十五功臣，以成德為殿。

translations.literal: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first fifteen meritorious officials, with Cheng De at the end.
translations.idiomatic: His likeness joined the first fifteen portraits in the Hall of Purple Splendor, Cheng De closing the group.

sentences.zh: 尋命署杭州將軍。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was ordered to act as General of Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed acting General of Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 仁宗即位，移署荊州將軍。

translations.literal: When Emperor Renzong succeeded, he was transferred to act as General of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Renzong he moved to acting General of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 教匪起，成德偕總督惠齡攻賊宜都灌灣腦山，擒賊首張正謨。

translations.literal: When the White Lotus rebels rose, Cheng De with Governor Huling attacked the rebels at Guanwan'nao Mountain in Yidu and captured the bandit chief Zhang Zhengmo.
translations.idiomatic: In the White Lotus rising he and Governor Huling attacked rebels at Guanwan'nao in Yidu and seized chief Zhang Zhengmo.

sentences.zh: 尋以縱賊竄逸，奪勇號。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, for letting rebels escape, his brave-title was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: He soon lost his honorific martial title for allowing rebels to slip away.

sentences.zh: 四年，致仕，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he retired and died.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 he retired and died.

sentences.zh: 以曾孫女配宣宗為孝全皇后，追封三等承恩公，諡威恪。

translations.literal: Because his great-granddaughter was married to Emperor Xuanzong as Empress Xiaoquan, he was posthumously enfeoffed as third-rank Duke of Inherited Grace with the posthumous name Weike.
translations.idiomatic: His great-granddaughter became Empress Xiaoquan to Emperor Xuanzong; he was posthumously made third-rank Duke of Inherited Grace with the posthumous name Weike.

sentences.zh: 子穆克登布，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Mukedengbu has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Mukedengbu has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 馬彪，甘肅西寧人。

translations.literal: Ma Biao was a native of Xining in Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Biao came from Xining in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 以行伍從軍，累遷至四川川北鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Entering the army from the ranks, he rose in succession to commander of the Chuandao garrison in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to commander of the Chuandao garrison in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 高台縣丞邱天寵私伐巴彥濟魯薩林木，貝勒羅卜藏達爾札訴於上，詞連彪，奪職。

translations.literal: Gaotai Assistant Magistrate Qiu Tianchong privately felled timber at Bayan Jilusa; Prince Luobuzang Da'erzha complained to the throne, implicating Biao, and his office was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: When Assistant Magistrate Qiu Tianchong illegally logged Bayan Jilusa timber, Prince Luobuzang Da'erzha's memorial implicated Biao and cost him his post.

sentences.zh: 尋賜游擊銜，駐雅爾。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was granted the rank of guerrilla commander and stationed at Yarkand.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon given guerrilla rank and posted to Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 復起，除雲南昭通鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Restored to office, he was appointed commander of the Zhaotong garrison in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Reinstated, he became commander of the Zhaotong garrison in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十六年，師徵金川，將軍溫福以彪屢出師勇往，令將貴州兵三千以從，克巴朗拉碉卡，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year of Qianlong, when the army campaigned against Jinchuan, General Wen Fu, because Biao had repeatedly led troops with courage, ordered him to command three thousand Guizhou troops in the campaign; they captured Balangla blockhouses and stockades and he was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 36, Wen Fu valued Biao's repeated bravery in the field and gave him three thousand Guizhou troops; they took Balangla forts and Biao received the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 師自達木巴宗分三道趨資哩，彪偕侍衛額森特等自北山進，奪賊碉卡，斬馘百餘，與師會。

translations.literal: The army split into three columns toward Zili from Dambazong; Biao with Bodyguard Esente and others advanced from the northern mountain, seized rebel blockhouses and stockades, killed more than a hundred, and joined the main force.
translations.idiomatic: From Dambazong three columns moved on Zili; Biao with Esente advanced from the north ridge, took enemy forts, killed over a hundred, and linked with the main army.

sentences.zh: 彪以貴州兵二千駐資哩北山梁，東西距三十餘裡。

translations.literal: Biao stationed two thousand Guizhou troops on the northern ridge of Zili, spanning more than thirty li east to west.
translations.idiomatic: Biao held the north ridge of Zili with two thousand Guizhou men across more than thirty li.

sentences.zh: 賊夜犯都司黃壯略、守備王廷玉營，彪與侍衛巴三泰馳援，敗賊，失砲三。

translations.literal: Rebels attacked at night the camps of Brigade Commander Huang Zhuanglue and Garrison Commander Wang Tingyu; Biao with Bodyguard Ba Santai rode to the rescue and defeated the rebels, but three cannon were lost.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels night-assaulted Huang Zhuanglue and Wang Tingyu; Biao and Ba Santai rode to their aid and repulsed the enemy, though three guns were lost.

sentences.zh: 上以彪戰甚力，不之罪。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because Biao had fought very hard, did not punish him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not punish him, noting how fiercely he had fought.

sentences.zh: 嗣都司徐大勇等守色布色爾，賊屯十里外高峰。

translations.literal: Later Brigade Commander Xu Dayong and others held Sebuse'er while rebels camped on a peak ten li away.
translations.idiomatic: Later Xu Dayong held Sebuse'er while rebels encamped on a peak ten li off.

sentences.zh: 參贊五岱檄彪赴援，未至，副將色倫泰戰沒。

translations.literal: Grand Minister Consultant Wu Dai ordered Biao to reinforce them; before he arrived, Deputy Commander Selentai was killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dai ordered Biao to reinforce them; before he arrived Deputy Commander Selentai fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 五岱劾彪逗遛，當奪職，上命留任。

translations.literal: Wu Dai impeached Biao for delay and his office should have been stripped; the Emperor ordered him kept in post.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dai charged Biao with dawdling and sought his dismissal; the emperor kept him on duty.

sentences.zh: 尋自碩藏噶爾進駐色布色爾，阿桂軍次喇卜楚克山麓，偪木闌壩；

translations.literal: Soon afterward, advancing from Shuocangg'er he encamped at Sebuse'er; Agui's army halted on the slope of Labuchuke Mountain, pressing Mulangba;
translations.idiomatic: He soon moved from Shuocangg'er to Sebuse'er while Agui's host camped on Labuchuke slope threatening Mulangba;

sentences.zh: 令彪伏兵東崖下，克其水碉。

translations.literal: Biao was ordered to lie in ambush below the eastern cliff and captured the water blockhouse.
translations.idiomatic: Biao was told to ambush under the east cliff and took the river fort.

sentences.zh: 進攻色爾渠，彪從參贊豐升額等擊東瑪砦，克之。

translations.literal: Advancing against Se'erqu, Biao with Grand Minister Consultant Feng Sheng'e and others attacked Dongma stockade and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing Se'erqu, Biao with Feng Sheng'e stormed Dongma stockade and took it.

sentences.zh: 乘勝攻哲木剋郭羅郭羅美羅喇嘛寺諸寨，皆下，奪碉五，俘馘數十。

translations.literal: Pressing the advantage they attacked the stockades of Zhemuke, Guoluoguo, Meiluo Lama Temple, and others; all fell, and they seized five blockhouses and captured or killed several dozen.
translations.idiomatic: They swept Zhemuke, Guoluoguo, Meiluo Lama Temple, and other strongpoints, taking five forts and dozens of prisoners and heads.

sentences.zh: 攻美美卡，彪率二百人自山梁小徑入。

translations.literal: Attacking Meimeika, Biao led two hundred men in by a small path over the ridge.
translations.idiomatic: At Meimeika Biao took two hundred men along a ridge trail.

sentences.zh: 賊來援，力戰破之。

translations.literal: Relieving rebels came; he fought hard and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: When relief arrived he fought them off.

sentences.zh: 美美卡至日喀爾橋，有小徑曰兜烏。

translations.literal: From Meimeika to Rike'er Bridge there was a small path called Douwu.
translations.idiomatic: Between Meimeika and Rike'er Bridge a path called Douwu ran.

sentences.zh: 賊毀橋築卡以拒，彪伐木為橋濟兵，賊棄卡走。

translations.literal: Rebels destroyed the bridge and built a stockade to block it; Biao felled trees to make a bridge and cross troops, and the rebels abandoned the stockade and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels wrecked the bridge and walled the pass; Biao bridged it with felled timber, and the enemy fled.

sentences.zh: 又與提督哈國興合克喀木色爾穆拉斯郭寨，遂據兜烏。

translations.literal: Again, together with Provincial Commander Ha Guoxing, he jointly captured Kamuse'er and Mulasiguo stockades and then held Douwu.
translations.idiomatic: With Commander Ha Guoxing he also took Kamuse'er and Mulasiguo and held Douwu.

sentences.zh: 尋自達克蘇山後攻明郭宗，彪將千人自格實迪下攻，賊棄碉竄，授西安提督。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, attacking Mingguozong from behind Dakusu Mountain, Biao led a thousand men down from Geshidi; the rebels abandoned their blockhouses and fled, and he was appointed provincial commander of Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: He next hit Mingguozong from behind Dakusu with a thousand men down Geshidi; rebels abandoned their forts and fled, and he was made Xi'an commander.

sentences.zh: 复偕侍衛烏爾圖納遜攻達爾圖大碉，斃竄賊甚多。

translations.literal: Again with Bodyguard Wul'tunaxun he attacked the great blockhouse at Da'ertu and killed many fleeing rebels.
translations.idiomatic: With Wul'tunaxun he stormed the great fort at Da'ertu and killed many fugitives.

sentences.zh: 遂偕領隊大臣華善等以六千人駐宜喜，賊來犯，擊之，斬賊三十餘人。

translations.literal: Then with Leading Minister Huashan and others he stationed six thousand men at Yixi; rebels came to attack and were repulsed, with more than thirty rebels killed.
translations.idiomatic: He then garrisoned six thousand at Yixi with Huashan; rebels attacked and were beaten off with over thirty killed.

sentences.zh: 以三千五百人攻達爾圖碉，未下。

translations.literal: With three thousand five hundred men he attacked the Da'ertu blockhouse but did not take it.
translations.idiomatic: He assaulted Da'ertu fort with three thousand five hundred men but failed to take it.

sentences.zh: 賊自沙壩三道襲宜喜軍，又別遣賊夜撲達爾圖軍，擊走之。

translations.literal: Rebels from Shaba attacked the Yixi army in three columns while others by night struck the Da'ertu force; both attacks were beaten off.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels hit Yixi in three columns from Shaba and by night struck Da'ertu; both assaults were repulsed.

sentences.zh: 師克乃當，至獨松，彪與賊戰中巴布里、下巴布里及瑪雅岡角木，賊皆棄寨遁。

translations.literal: When the army took Naidang and reached Dusong, Biao fought rebels at Zhongbabuli, Xiababuli, and Mayaogang Jiaomu; the rebels all abandoned their stockades and fled.
translations.idiomatic: As the army took Naidang and reached Dusong, Biao fought at Zhongbabuli, Xiababuli, and Mayaogang Jiaomu and drove the enemy from every post.

sentences.zh: 旋與副將欽保克爾瑪及札烏古山梁，與總兵敖成克甲索。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, with Deputy Commander Qinbao he took Ke'erma and Zhawugu Ridge, and with Commander Ao Cheng he took Jiasuo.
translations.idiomatic: He soon took Ke'erma and Zhawugu Ridge with Qinbao and Jiasuo with Ao Cheng.

sentences.zh: 金川平，赴西安任。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified he went to take up his post at Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinchuan was pacified he proceeded to his Xi'an command.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first fifty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinchuan was pacified his likeness joined the first fifty honorees in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 移湖廣提督。

translations.literal: He was transferred to provincial commander of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Huguang provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈太子太保，諡勤襄，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: He died; posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous name Qinxiang and granted a hereditary office as Commandant of Light Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: He died and was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous name Qinxiang and a hereditary commandant of light chariots.

sentences.zh: 常青，蘇木剋氏，滿洲鑲白旗人。

translations.literal: Chang Qing, of the Sumuke clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Qing, of the Sumuke clan, belonged to the Manchu Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 自前鋒累遷護軍參領。

translations.literal: From vanguard he rose in succession to guard colonel.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from vanguard to guard colonel.

sentences.zh: 外擢雲南曲尋鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Externally he was promoted to commander of the Qujing garrison in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted as commander of the Qujing garrison in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 從將軍明瑞討緬甸，戰於蠻結。

translations.literal: He followed General Mingrui to suppress Burma and fought at Manjie.
translations.idiomatic: He followed General Mingrui against Burma and fought at Manjie.

sentences.zh: 明瑞將中軍，常青與領隊大臣觀音保踞西山梁。

translations.literal: Mingrui commanded the center army; Chang Qing with Leading Minister Guanyinbao held the western mountain ridge.
translations.idiomatic: Mingrui led the center while Chang Qing and Leading Minister Guanyinbao held the western ridge.

sentences.zh: 賊突至，常青等奮擊，馘二百餘；

translations.literal: Rebels suddenly arrived; Chang Qing and others fought hard and took more than two hundred heads;
translations.idiomatic: When rebels struck suddenly Chang Qing and others fought fiercely and took over two hundred heads;

sentences.zh: 賊敗竄，又馘二千餘，俘三十四。

translations.literal: the rebels were defeated and fled, and more than two thousand were killed and thirty-four captured.
translations.idiomatic: the enemy broke and fled, leaving more than two thousand dead and thirty-four prisoners.

sentences.zh: 再戰天生橋、宋寨、黃土岡諸地，屢敗賊。

translations.literal: Fighting again at Tiansheng Bridge, Song stockade, Huangtu Hill, and other places, they repeatedly defeated the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: At Tiansheng Bridge, Song stockade, Huangtu Hill, and elsewhere they repeatedly beat the enemy.

sentences.zh: 明瑞軍敗績，上召常青入對，命仍還雲南，從副將軍阿里袞出萬仞關。

translations.literal: When Mingrui's army suffered defeat, the Emperor summoned Chang Qing for audience and ordered him back to Yunnan to follow Deputy General Aligün out through Wanyun Pass.
translations.idiomatic: After Mingrui's defeat the emperor recalled Chang Qing and sent him back to Yunnan to follow Deputy General Aligün through Wanyun Pass.

sentences.zh: 經略大學士傅恆令詣野牛壩督造戰船，率兵赴新街，殺賊奪寨，獲敵舟及糧械。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Fu Heng ordered him to Yeniuba to supervise construction of warships, then led troops to Xinjie, killed rebels, seized stockades, and captured enemy boats and grain and weapons.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Heng had him build warships at Yeniuba, then led troops to Xinjie, killed rebels, took stockades, and captured enemy boats, grain, and arms.

sentences.zh: 旋自新街進攻老官屯，克毛西寨。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he advanced from Xinjie against Laoguantun and captured Maoxi stockade.
translations.idiomatic: He soon advanced from Xinjie on Laoguantun and took Maoxi stockade.

sentences.zh: 師還，授雲南提督。

translations.literal: When the army withdrew he was appointed provincial commander of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: After the withdrawal he became Yunnan provincial commander.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十八年，師徵金川，令率雲南兵二千赴打箭爐佐將軍阿桂出西路。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year of Qianlong, when the army campaigned against Jinchuan, he was ordered to lead two thousand Yunnan troops to Dajianlu to assist General Agui on the western route.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 38 he was told to lead two thousand Yunnan troops to Dajianlu to support Agui's western column.

sentences.zh: 偕都統海蘭察攻斯達克拉、阿噶爾布里、碩藏噶爾諸山梁，克之，留屯美諾。

translations.literal: Together with Lieutenant-General Hailanqa he attacked the ridges of Sidakela, Aga'erbuli, and Shuocangg'er, captured them, and remained garrisoned at Meinuo.
translations.idiomatic: With Hailanqa he took the ridges of Sidakela, Aga'erbuli, and Shuocangg'er and garrisoned Meinuo.

sentences.zh: 師攻布朗郭宗，阿桂奏請常青策應。

translations.literal: When the army attacked Bulangguozong, Agui memorialized asking Chang Qing to coordinate support.
translations.idiomatic: During the assault on Bulangguozong Agui asked Chang Qing to coordinate support.

sentences.zh: 常青遣游擊福敏泰駐木波，游擊保寧駐噶魯什呢，守備張啟貴駐美臥溝，而與副都統富興率兵為布朗郭宗聲援。

translations.literal: Chang Qing sent Guerrilla Commander Fu Mintai to garrison Mubo, Guerrilla Commander Baoning to Galushini, Garrison Commander Zhang Qigui to Mei'ogou, while he and Deputy Lieutenant-General Fuxing led troops to support Bulangguozong.
translations.idiomatic: He posted Fu Mintai at Mubo, Baoning at Galushini, Zhang Qigui at Mei'ogou, and with Fuxing supported the Bulangguozong attack.

sentences.zh: 西藏語謂為盜曰「放夾壩」，常青與富興督綠營兵捕盜，焚其林。

translations.literal: In Tibetan a bandit is called 'fangjiaba'; Chang Qing and Fuxing directed Green Standard troops to capture bandits and burn their woods.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetans call bandits fangjiaba; Chang Qing and Fuxing sent Green Standard troops to hunt them and burn their woods.

sentences.zh: 阿桂師進攻勒烏圍，常青與富勒渾護餉道，自明郭宗至大板昭，兵卒巡視，分守小沙壩、沙壩、三松坪諸地，自間道出功噶爾拉擊賊。

translations.literal: When Agui's army attacked Lewuwei, Chang Qing with Fulehun guarded the grain route from Mingguozong to Daban Zhao, with soldiers patrolling and holding Xiaoshaba, Shaba, Sansongping, and other places, and struck rebels by a side path from Gongga'erla.
translations.idiomatic: During the Lewuwei assault Chang Qing and Fulehun secured supplies from Mingguozong to Daban Zhao, patrolled Xiaoshaba, Shaba, and Sansongping, and hit rebels via a side path at Gongga'erla.

sentences.zh: 上嘉之，諭以此路官軍久未進攻，今自間道出奇，足以綴賊；

translations.literal: The Emperor praised this, saying that on this route government troops had long failed to attack, and that now a surprise move by a side path was enough to pin the rebels;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised the move, noting that imperial troops had long stalled on that route and that a flanking surprise could now fix the enemy;

sentences.zh: 惟地勢險峻，仍戒其輕舉。

translations.literal: but because the terrain was dangerous and steep, he still warned against rash action.
translations.idiomatic: yet warned against rash advances given the steep ground.

sentences.zh: 金川平，圖形紫光閣，列後五十功臣。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the last fifty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinchuan was pacified his likeness joined the last fifty portraits in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 移古北口提督，而以海祿代之。

translations.literal: He was transferred to provincial commander at Gubeikou, with Hai Lu replacing him.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to Gubeikou commander while Hai Lu took his Yunnan post.

sentences.zh: 疏言緬甸方議撫，請暫留張鳳街，與海祿相機籌辦。

translations.literal: He memorialized that Burma was then negotiating pacification and asked to retain Zhang Fengjie to plan with Hai Lu as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to keep Zhang Fengjie in Burma to coordinate with Hai Lu while negotiations proceeded.

sentences.zh: 上以夷性多疑，文檄仍用常青舊銜，俟事定赴新任。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because the barbarians were suspicious by nature, still used Chang Qing's old title in documents and ordered him to take up his new post only when affairs were settled.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor kept Chang Qing's old title on documents until Burma was settled, citing Burmese suspicion.

sentences.zh: 歷浙江、江南、直隸、福建陸路提督，又繼海祿為烏魯木齊都統，移西安將軍。

translations.literal: He served in succession as provincial commander of Zhejiang, Jiangnan, Zhili, and Fujian infantry, then succeeded Hai Lu as lieutenant-general at Urumqi and was transferred to General of Xi'an.
translations.idiomatic: He later commanded in Zhejiang, Jiangnan, Zhili, and Fujian, succeeded Hai Lu at Urumqi, and became General of Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡莊毅。

translations.literal: He died; posthumous name Zhuangyi.
translations.idiomatic: He died and received the posthumous name Zhuangyi.

sentences.zh: 官達色，瓜爾佳氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Guan Da Se, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Da Se, of the Guwalgiya clan, belonged to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 以前鋒從征準噶爾。

translations.literal: As a vanguard he followed the campaign against the Dzungars.
translations.idiomatic: He served as a vanguard in the Dzungar campaign.

sentences.zh: 將軍兆惠自鄂壘扎拉圖轉戰至特訥格爾，上方南巡，遣官達色及副護軍校兆坦齎疏詣行在，召對，授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: When General Zhaohui fought from Elezhalatu to Tenege'er, the Emperor was on southern tour and sent Guan Da Se and Acting Guard Colonel Zhaotan with memorials to the traveling palace; summoned to audience, he was appointed a blue-lance bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhaohui fought from Elezhalatu to Tenege'er the emperor was touring the south; Guan Da Se and Zhaotan carried memorials to the traveling palace, were received in audience, and he was made a blue-lance bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 準噶爾平，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: When the Dzungars were pacified he was granted a hereditary office as Commandant of Light Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: After the Dzungar pacification he received a hereditary commandant of light cavalry.

sentences.zh: 迭遷副參領，外擢雲南順雲營參將。

translations.literal: Rising in succession to deputy colonel, he was promoted externally to brigade commander of the Shunyun camp in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to deputy colonel and was posted brigade commander of Shunyun camp in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 自陳不通漢文，乞還京師，經略大學士傅恆討緬甸，以官達色監鑄砲，令從軍。

translations.literal: He stated that he did not know Chinese and begged to return to the capital; when Grand Secretary Fu Heng campaigned against Burma he was put in charge of casting cannon and ordered to follow the army.
translations.idiomatic: Claiming no Chinese literacy he asked to return to the capital; when Fu Heng campaigned in Burma he supervised cannon casting and joined the army.

sentences.zh: 旋授健銳營前鋒參領。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed vanguard colonel of the Vanguard Camp.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made vanguard colonel of the Vanguard Camp.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十六年，將軍溫福徵金川，令將成都駐防兵四百人從攻巴朗拉山梁，與烏什哈達督兵自山右登，奪卡六。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year of Qianlong, when General Wen Fu campaigned against Jinchuan, he was ordered to lead four hundred Chengdu garrison troops to attack the Balangla ridge with Wu Shenhada directing troops up from the right of the mountain; they seized six stockades.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 36 Wen Fu's Jinchuan campaign sent him with four hundred Chengdu garrison troops against Balangla ridge; with Wu Shenhada on the right they took six stockades.

sentences.zh: 再戰，官達色發砲毀賊碉，戰三晝夜，克之，賜號巴爾丹巴圖魯，畀白金百。

translations.literal: Fighting again, Guan Da Se fired cannon and destroyed rebel blockhouses; after three days and nights of battle they captured the position; he was granted the title Bardamba Batüru and given one hundred taels of white silver.
translations.idiomatic: In renewed fighting he shelled rebel forts for three days and nights until they fell; he received the title Bardamba Batüru and one hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 師逾達木巴宗至斯底葉安，賊力拒，官達色發砲隳其碉樓，命署四川松潘鎮總兵。

translations.literal: The army crossed Dambazong to Sidiye'an; the rebels resisted fiercely; Guan Da Se shelled and destroyed their blockhouse tower and was appointed acting commander of the Songpan garrison in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing Dambazong to Sidiye'an he bombarded a rebel tower into ruin and was made acting Songpan commander.

sentences.zh: 師乘雪擊賊，賊引退。

translations.literal: The army struck the rebels in the snow and the rebels withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The army attacked in snow and the rebels pulled back.

sentences.zh: 官達色逐賊，賊亂流渡，竄河喀木雅。

translations.literal: Guan Da Se pursued; the rebels crossed the stream in disorder and fled to Hekamuya.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Da Se pursued as they fled across the stream toward Hekamuya.

sentences.zh: 移軍逼賊寨，官達色發砲擊之，寨垂破，賊夜遁。

translations.literal: Moving the army to press the rebel stockade, Guan Da Se shelled it; the stockade was on the verge of falling when the rebels fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing the rebel stockade he shelled it nearly to collapse before the enemy fled by night.
