sentences.zh: 溫福督師攻南山，官達色與總兵牛天畀合軍，天畀取第二碉，官達色取第三碉，復命署湖北襄陽鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Wen Fu directed the army to attack the southern mountain; Guan Da Se joined Commander Niu Tianbi; Tianbi took the second blockhouse and Guan Da Se the third; he was again appointed acting commander of the Xiangyang garrison in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu attacked the south slope; Guan Da Se and Niu Tianbi took the second and third forts respectively, and he was made acting Xiangyang commander.

sentences.zh: 師攻達爾圖，賊蔽碉為固，官達色發砲擊之，日斃賊數十。

translations.literal: When the army attacked Da'ertu the rebels sheltered behind blockhouses; Guan Da Se shelled them and killed several dozen rebels each day.
translations.idiomatic: At Da'ertu rebels hid in forts; Guan Da Se's guns killed dozens daily.

sentences.zh: 師進，破碉二，拔柵，殲賊甚眾。

translations.literal: The army advanced, broke two blockhouses, pulled up palisades, and killed very many rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The column advanced, smashed two forts, tore up palisades, and killed a great many.

sentences.zh: 副將軍豐升額攻谷噶，官達色與侍衛普濟保等以四千人往會。

translations.literal: Deputy General Feng Sheng'e attacked Guga; Guan Da Se with Bodyguard Pujibao and others joined him with four thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: When Feng Sheng'e attacked Guga, Guan Da Se brought four thousand men with Pujibao to join him.

sentences.zh: 旋以將軍阿桂檄，從參贊海蘭察攻喇穆喇穆，奪卡三，逼碉下擲火彈，以雨不燃，暫引退。

translations.literal: Soon, on General Agui's order, he followed Consultant Hailanqa against Lamulamu, seized three stockades, and threw fire bombs below the blockhouses; rain prevented them from igniting and they withdrew temporarily.
translations.idiomatic: On Agui's orders he followed Hailanqa at Lamulamu, took three stockades, and tried fire bombs under the forts, but rain forced a temporary withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 復以六百人直陟高峰，峰有大碉二，夜半，援石壁蟻附登，伏碉旁，黎明突起，遂破二碉。

translations.literal: Again with six hundred men he climbed straight to the summit; on the peak were two large blockhouses; at midnight they scaled the stone cliff like ants, lay in ambush beside the blockhouses, and at dawn sprang up and broke both blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: With six hundred men he scaled the summit at midnight like ants up a cliff, ambushed beside two great forts, and at dawn stormed both.

sentences.zh: 進攻該布達什諾，賊為大碉倚壕，輔以木城。

translations.literal: Advancing against Gaibudashi's Nuomucheng, the rebels had a large blockhouse leaning on a moat with a wooden fort as support.
translations.idiomatic: At Gaibudashi's Nuomucheng the enemy held a great fort behind a moat with a wooden citadel.

sentences.zh: 官達色督兵冒槍石躍壕以度，劃碉址成，遂援以上。

translations.literal: Guan Da Se directed troops to brave gunfire and leap the moat; they cut steps into the blockhouse wall and climbed up.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Da Se led men through gunfire over the moat, cut steps into the fort wall, and climbed up.

sentences.zh: 賊退保木城，阿桂令海蘭察出城後，官達色當其前，力戰克之。

translations.literal: The rebels retreated to the wooden fort; Agui ordered Hailanqa to come out behind the fort while Guan Da Se faced the front and fought hard to capture it.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy fell back to the wooden fort; Agui sent Hailanqa around the rear while Guan Da Se attacked frontally and took it.

sentences.zh: 再進，攻默格爾山梁，官達色與額森特等合軍取碉三。

translations.literal: Advancing again, they attacked Mogeer Ridge; Guan Da Se with Esente and others joined forces and took three blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing on to Mogeer Ridge he and Esente jointly took three forts.

sentences.zh: 旋與海蘭察、額森特分道裹糧深入，攻格魯克古丫口，克當噶海寨及陡烏當噶大碉，焚沙木拉渠寨。

translations.literal: Soon he divided forces with Hailanqa and Esente, carrying rations deep inside to attack Gelukeguyakou, captured Dangga Sea stockade and the great blockhouse at Dou'udangga, and burned Shamulaqu stockade.
translations.idiomatic: He then split with Hailanqa and Esente, carried rations deep inland, took Gelukeguyakou, Dangga Sea stockade, the great fort at Dou'udangga, and burned Shamulaqu.

sentences.zh: 循格魯克古山梁以下，賊傍箐置卡，督兵攻之下。

translations.literal: Following down Gelukegu Ridge, rebels placed stockades along ravines; he directed troops to attack downward.
translations.idiomatic: Moving down Gelukegu Ridge he stormed enemy posts set along the ravines.

sentences.zh: 真除襄陽鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He was confirmed as commander of the Xiangyang garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He was confirmed as Xiangyang commander.

sentences.zh: 再進，攻勒吉爾博，戰於山麓，破賊碉；

translations.literal: Advancing again, they attacked Leji'erbo and fought at the mountain foot, breaking rebel blockhouses;
translations.idiomatic: He advanced again on Leji'erbo, fought at the foot of the slope, and broke enemy forts;

sentences.zh: 再進，攻榮克爾博，克其麓木城。

translations.literal: advancing again, they attacked Rongke'erbo and captured the wooden fort at its foot.
translations.idiomatic: then took Rongke'erbo and its foothill wooden fort.

sentences.zh: 督兵陟山巔，與普爾普逾溝拔木柵二十六。

translations.literal: He directed troops to the mountain crest and with Pu'erpu crossed ravines and pulled up twenty-six wooden palisades.
translations.idiomatic: He climbed the summit with Pu'erpu, crossed gullies, and tore up twenty-six wooden palisades.

sentences.zh: 自舍圖柱卡循昆色爾山梁，攻據雅木則碉，取果克山諸碉寨，圍拉枯喇嘛寺，盡殲之。

translations.literal: From Shetuwang stockade along Kunse'er Ridge he attacked and seized the Yamuze blockhouse, took the forts and stockades of Guoke Mountain, invested Laku Lama Temple, and annihilated all within.
translations.idiomatic: From Shetuwang along Kunse'er Ridge he took Yamuze fort, Guoke Mountain posts, besieged Laku Lama Temple, and wiped out the garrison.

sentences.zh: 再進，與海蘭察等同攻章噶，賊綠碉鑿深溝，設柵其上，官達色督兵拔柵以覆溝，援附至碉巔下攻，賊驚竄，遂克之。

translations.literal: Advancing again, together with Hailanqa and others he attacked Zhangga; the rebels' green blockhouse had a deep trench cut and palisades set above; Guan Da Se directed troops to pull up palisades to fill the trench, ladders were set to the foot of the blockhouse summit for attack, the rebels fled in alarm, and it was captured.
translations.idiomatic: With Hailanqa he assaulted Zhangga; rebels had dug a deep trench under a green fort with palisades above; Guan Da Se's men filled the trench with palisades, scaled the wall, and the enemy fled.

sentences.zh: 與海蘭察合軍向勒烏圍，分攻隆斯得，其地有三寨，克其二；

translations.literal: Joining Hailanqa's army toward Lewuwei, they divided forces to attack Longside; there were three stockades there and two were taken;
translations.idiomatic: With Hailanqa toward Lewuwei they split to attack Longside, taking two of three stockades;

sentences.zh: 遂潛破後寨，寨內蓄鉛子，積地二尺許，火藥百餘簍，悉收以佐軍，設砲台，偪轉經樓，與保寧、彰靄合軍克之，勒烏圍亦下。

translations.literal: then they secretly broke the rear stockade; within the stockade were stored lead balls piled two feet deep on the ground and more than a hundred baskets of gunpowder; all were collected to aid the army; artillery platforms were set to press the scripture hall; together with Baoning and Zhang'ai they joined forces and captured it, and Lewuwei also fell.
translations.idiomatic: then secretly stormed the rear stockade, seizing lead shot piled two feet deep and over a hundred baskets of powder for the army, set guns against the scripture hall, joined Baoning and Zhang'ai, and Lewuwei fell.

sentences.zh: 與海蘭察等攻達烏，連破諸碉寨。

translations.literal: Together with Hailanqa and others he attacked Dawu and captured blockhouses and stockades in succession.
translations.idiomatic: With Hailanqa he took Dawu and a chain of forts and stockades.

sentences.zh: 進攻西里，賊四出力禦，官達色逾溝與戰，賊穿林逃。

translations.literal: Advancing against Xili, the rebels came out in four directions to resist; Guan Da Se crossed the ravine to fight and the rebels fled through the woods.
translations.idiomatic: At Xili rebels resisted from four sides; Guan Da Se crossed the ditch to fight and drove them into the woods.

sentences.zh: 攻黃草坪，海蘭察當其前，官達色與海祿拔溝北柵為應。

translations.literal: Attacking Huangcaoping, Hailanqa faced the front while Guan Da Se with Hai Lu pulled up the northern palisades across the ravine as support.
translations.idiomatic: At Huangcaoping Hailanqa led the front while Guan Da Se and Hai Lu tore up northern palisades across the ravine in support.

sentences.zh: 攻奔布魯木峰木城，亦與海蘭察偕。

translations.literal: Attacking the wooden fort on Benbulumu Peak, he again acted together with Hailanqa.
translations.idiomatic: He again paired with Hailanqa against the wooden fort on Benbulumu Peak.

sentences.zh: 攻瓦喇佔，發砲破其碉。

translations.literal: Attacking Wala Zhan, he fired cannon and broke its blockhouse.
translations.idiomatic: At Wala Zhan his guns smashed the enemy fort.

sentences.zh: 循瓦喇佔而下曰薩爾歪，有寨三，海蘭察當其前，官達色與烏什哈達左右合擊，賊棄寨走，邀殪之。

translations.literal: Below Wala Zhan was Sa'erwai with three stockades; Hailanqa faced the front while Guan Da Se with Wu Shenhada struck left and right; the rebels abandoned the stockades and fled and were intercepted and killed.
translations.idiomatic: Below Wala Zhan lay Sa'erwai with three stockades; Hailanqa led the front, Guan Da Se and Wu Shenhada the flanks; fleeing rebels were cut down.

sentences.zh: 攻科布曲木城，又與海蘭察偕，官達色冒槍石先登。

translations.literal: Attacking Kebuqu wooden fort, he again acted with Hailanqa; Guan Da Se braved gunfire to climb first.
translations.idiomatic: At Kebuqu wooden fort he again fought with Hailanqa and was first up the wall under fire.

sentences.zh: 攻朗阿古，海蘭察自山腰險徑度兵，官達色與烏什哈達出其左。

translations.literal: Attacking Lang'agu, Hailanqa led troops over a dangerous path on the mountainside while Guan Da Se with Wu Shenhada came out on their left.
translations.idiomatic: At Lang'agu Hailanqa took a cliff path while Guan Da Se and Wu Shenhada struck from the left.

sentences.zh: 攻雍中喇嘛寺，官達色與普爾普等自右入，皆力戰殺賊，遂破噶拉依。

translations.literal: Attacking Yongzhong Lama Temple, Guan Da Se with Pu'erpu and others entered from the right; all fought hard and killed rebels, and Galayi was finally broken.
translations.idiomatic: At Yongzhong Lama Temple he entered from the right with Pu'erpu; fierce fighting broke Galayi.

sentences.zh: 金川平，圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣，予一等輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first fifty meritorious officials and he was granted a first-rank hereditary office as Commandant of Light Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinchuan was pacified his likeness joined the first fifty honorees and he received a first-rank hereditary commandant of light chariots.

sentences.zh: 移山西大同鎮總兵，再移直隸宣化總鎮兵。

translations.literal: He was transferred to commander of the Datong garrison in Shanxi, then again to commander of the Xuanhua garrison in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He became Datong commander in Shanxi, then Xuanhua commander in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 烏什哈達，吉林滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Wu Shenhada was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner from Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Shenhada was a Jilin Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 師徵緬甸，以前鋒校從，有功，賜號法福哩巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the Burma campaign he followed as a vanguard corporal with merit and was granted the title Fafuri Batüru.
translations.idiomatic: In the Burma war he served as vanguard corporal with distinction and received the title Fafuri Batüru.

sentences.zh: 師徵金川，以三等侍衛從，其與官達色同克巴朗拉也，賊攻據所駐山，复力戰破賊，奪其山還。

translations.literal: In the Jinchuan campaign he followed as a third-rank bodyguard; at Balangla, which he captured together with Guan Da Se, rebels attacked and seized the mountain where he was stationed; he again fought hard, broke the rebels, and recovered the mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jinchuan war, third-rank bodyguard, he and Guan Da Se took Balangla; when rebels seized his hill he fought them off and retook it.

sentences.zh: 事聞，上以功過足相當，宥之。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the Emperor held that merit and fault balanced each other and pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ruled merit and fault balanced and pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 戰屢有功，累擢正藍旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: He fought repeatedly with merit and rose in succession to deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Repeated victories raised him to deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 師還，圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣，予騎都尉兼雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: When the army withdrew, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first fifty meritorious officials and he was granted hereditary offices as Commandant of Cavalry and Commandant of Light Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On withdrawal his likeness joined the first fifty portraits and he received hereditary commandant of cavalry and light cavalry.

sentences.zh: 外授和闐領隊大臣，訐辦事大臣德風受賂，按治不盡實，奪職。

translations.literal: Posted externally as leading minister at Khotan, he investigated Commissioner Defeng for taking bribes but did not establish the facts fully and his office was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: As Khotan leading minister he investigated Defeng for bribery but failed to prove the case fully and lost his post.

sentences.zh: 師徵台灣，以頭等侍衛從，與普爾普自茅港轉戰，通嘉義道。

translations.literal: In the Taiwan campaign he followed as a first-rank bodyguard; with Pu'erpu he fought from Maogang in succession and opened the route to Jiayi.
translations.idiomatic: In the Taiwan war, first-rank bodyguard, he and Pu'erpu fought from Maogang and cleared the road to Jiayi.

sentences.zh: 尋將水師至瑯嶠，獲莊大田，還前所賜勇號。

translations.literal: Soon he led the navy to Langqiao, captured Zhuang Datian, and had his former brave-title restored.
translations.idiomatic: He soon led the fleet to Langqiao, captured Zhuang Datian, and regained his martial honorific.

sentences.zh: 再圖形紫光閣，列後三十功臣。

translations.literal: His portrait was again placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the last thirty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: His likeness was painted again among the last thirty honorees in the Hall of Purple Splendor.

sentences.zh: 師徵廓爾喀，以鑲紅旗蒙古副都統從，先行治道，躓而傷。

translations.literal: In the Gurkha campaign he followed as deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Bordered Red Banner, going ahead to prepare the road; he stumbled and was injured.
translations.idiomatic: In the Gurkha war, Bordered Red Banner deputy lieutenant-general, he went ahead to open roads, stumbled, and was hurt.

sentences.zh: 師還，賞不及，入見，以為言。

translations.literal: When the army withdrew he did not receive reward; on audience he spoke of it.
translations.idiomatic: After the campaign he received no reward and complained at audience.

sentences.zh: 上責其巧佞，奪職，戍伊犁。

translations.literal: The Emperor rebuked him for crafty flattery, stripped his office, and banished him to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor called him sly and flattering, stripped him, and exiled him to Ili.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，赦還。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jiaqing reign he was pardoned and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jiaqing he was pardoned and returned.

sentences.zh: 師徵川、楚教匪，以頭等侍衛從，賊渠王三槐擁眾渡江，烏什哈達與戰，死之，予輕車都尉世職。

translations.literal: In the Sichuan-Huguang sectarian campaign he followed as a first-rank bodyguard; the bandit chief Wang Sanhuai led a crowd across the river; Wu Shenhada fought and died; he was granted a hereditary office as Commandant of Light Chariots.
translations.idiomatic: In the White Lotus war he followed as first-rank bodyguard; when Wang Sanhuai crossed the river Wu Shenhada fought and died, receiving a hereditary commandant of light chariots.

sentences.zh: 瑚尼勒圖，鄂訥氏，黑龍江人。

translations.literal: Hu Ni Le Tu, of the Ene clan, was a native of Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Ni Le Tu, of the Ene clan, came from Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 以護軍入滿洲鑲黃旗。

translations.literal: As a guardsman he entered the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner as a guardsman.

sentences.zh: 累遷護軍參領。

translations.literal: He rose in succession to guard colonel.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to guard colonel.

sentences.zh: 從征金川，亦與巴朗拉之役，賜號多卜丹巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Following the Jinchuan campaign, he also fought at Balangla and was granted the title Duobodan Batüru.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jinchuan campaign, including Balangla, he earned the title Duobodan Batüru.

sentences.zh: 攻資哩南山，戰自喇卜楚克山梁，繞登高峰，奪賊卡二，遂陟其巔，又奪賊卡二。

translations.literal: Attacking Zili Nanshan, he fought from Labuchuke Ridge, circled to climb the high peak, seized two rebel stockades, ascended the summit, and seized two more rebel stockades.
translations.idiomatic: At Zili Nanshan he fought from Labuchuke Ridge, circled to the summit, and took four enemy stockades in succession.

sentences.zh: 復從海蘭察等攻羅博瓦前山，賊二百餘自其右緣山梁斜上，瑚尼勒圖擊殺十餘人，賊遁走，進攻該布達什諾，克之，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: Again following Hailanqa and others he attacked the front slope of Luobowa Mountain; more than two hundred rebels climbed obliquely along the ridge from the right; Hu Ni Le Tu killed more than ten and the rebels fled; advancing against Gaibudashi's Nuomucheng he captured it and was given the rank of deputy lieutenant-general.
translations.idiomatic: With Hailanqa at Luobowa's forward slope he killed a dozen of two hundred rebels climbing the right ridge, took Gaibudashi's Nuomucheng, and received deputy lieutenant-general rank.

sentences.zh: 復進攻遜克爾宗，焚賊寨十餘，賊來援，卻之。

translations.literal: Advancing again against Xunke'erzong, he burned more than ten rebel stockades; relieving rebels came and were repulsed.
translations.idiomatic: At Xunke'erzong he burned over ten stockades and beat back relief columns.

sentences.zh: 師攻勒烏圍，遣瑚尼勒圖奪據默格爾山，進占日爾巴當噶爾之西。

translations.literal: When the army attacked Lewuwei, Hu Ni Le Tu was sent to seize Mogeer Mountain and advance to occupy the west of Ri'erbadangga'er.
translations.idiomatic: During the Lewuwei assault he seized Mogeer Mountain and held ground west of Ri'erbadangga'er.

sentences.zh: 危峰突起，海蘭察等更出其西，自密拉噶拉木山巔下擊，遂克凱立葉，諭嘉獎。

translations.literal: A perilous peak rose abruptly; Hailanqa and others went still further west and struck down from the summit of Milagalamu Mountain; Kailiye was captured and imperial praise was issued.
translations.idiomatic: From Milagalamu summit Hailanqa and others struck west down a sheer peak and took Kailiye to imperial praise.

sentences.zh: 乘勝攻克日爾巴當噶山陽左右五碉。

translations.literal: Pressing the advantage they captured the five blockhouses on the sunny and shady slopes of Ri'erbadangga Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: They then took five forts on both slopes of Ri'erbadangga Mountain.

sentences.zh: 又從海蘭察等攻取桑噶斯瑪特山寨。

translations.literal: Again following Hailanqa and others they attacked and captured Sanggasimate Mountain stockade.
translations.idiomatic: With Hailanqa he also stormed Sanggasimate Mountain stockade.

sentences.zh: 與福康安督兵將出箐，見賊碉二，奮勇躍入殺賊，賊潰，擢鑲藍旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: Together with Fuk'ang'an directing troops about to emerge from a ravine, he saw two rebel blockhouses, leaped in bravely and killed rebels, the rebels fled, and he was promoted to deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: With Fuk'ang'an he spotted two rebel forts, leaped in and routed the garrison, and was made Bordered Blue Banner deputy lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 師攻達佳布、安吉諸碉，督兵自山腰賊碉間攀越而過，先入碉，皆克之。

translations.literal: When the army attacked the blockhouses at Dajiabu and Anji, he directed troops to climb over between mid-mountain rebel blockhouses, entered the blockhouses first, and all were captured.
translations.idiomatic: At Dajiabu and Anji he led men climbing between mid-slope forts, entered first, and took them all.

sentences.zh: 進攻木思工噶克，令瑚尼勒圖攻丫口。

translations.literal: Advancing against Musigonggake, he was ordered to attack the pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the Musigonggake assault he was assigned the pass.

sentences.zh: 潛師而入，游擊梁朝桂等為繼，丫口峰左右碉十有四，同時皆破。

translations.literal: Troops stole in secretly with Guerrilla Commander Liang Chaogui and others following; fourteen blockhouses left and right on the pass peak were all broken at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: A stealth column with Liang Chaogui followed up; all fourteen forts on the pass crest fell together.

sentences.zh: 師次榮噶爾博，有山梁曰巴佔，為勒烏圍門戶，賊守禦甚力。

translations.literal: The army halted at Rongga'erbo; there was a ridge called Bazhan that was the gateway to Lewuwei, and the rebels defended it very stubbornly.
translations.idiomatic: At Rongga'erbo the Bazhan ridge guarded Lewuwei's gate and was fiercely held.

sentences.zh: 諸將議自舍圖柱卡間道入，而使瑚尼勒圖屯巴佔分賊勢。

translations.literal: The generals planned to enter by a side path from Shetuwang stockade while Hu Ni Le Tu garrisoned Bazhan to divide rebel strength.
translations.idiomatic: Generals proposed a side approach from Shetuwang while Hu Ni Le Tu pinned Bazhan.

sentences.zh: 師克章噶，瑚尼勒圖亦取巴佔。

translations.literal: When the army captured Zhangga, Hu Ni Le Tu also took Bazhan.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhangga fell Hu Ni Le Tu took Bazhan as well.

sentences.zh: 分攻隆斯得寨，以斧破寨門，獲所儲鉛藥，遂攻下勒烏圍。

translations.literal: Dividing forces to attack Longside stockade, they broke the stockade gate with axes, seized stored lead and gunpowder, and then attacked and took Lewuwei.
translations.idiomatic: They split to storm Longside, axed the gate, seized powder stores, and took Lewuwei.

sentences.zh: 復攻西里山梁，瑚尼勒圖與烏什哈達督兵徑陟，克大碉三、木城四。

translations.literal: Attacking Xili Ridge again, Hu Ni Le Tu with Wu Shenhada directed troops straight up the slope and captured three large blockhouses and four wooden forts.
translations.idiomatic: At Xili Ridge Hu Ni Le Tu and Wu Shenhada climbed straight up and took three great forts and four wooden works.

sentences.zh: 師攻西里正寨，與福康安以火攻破寨；

translations.literal: When the army attacked Xilizheng stockade, together with Fuk'ang'an they broke the stockade with fire;
translations.idiomatic: At Xilizheng stockade he and Fuk'ang'an burned the position in;

sentences.zh: 又與海蘭察取朗阿古，攻克得拉古碉卡；

translations.literal: again with Hailanqa he took Lang'agu and captured Delagu blockhouses and stockades;
translations.idiomatic: with Hailanqa he also took Lang'agu and Delagu forts;

sentences.zh: 復自巴薩沙進，取奇什磯官寨，與福康安等克雍中喇嘛寺。

translations.literal: advancing again from Basasha he took Qishi Ji official stockade and with Fuk'ang'an and others captured Yongzhong Lama Temple.
translations.idiomatic: from Basasha he took Qishi Ji stockade and with Fuk'ang'an seized Yongzhong Lama Temple.

sentences.zh: 金川平，圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣，轉鑲紅旗蒙副都統。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first fifty meritorious officials; he was transferred to deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinchuan he joined the first fifty portraits and was transferred to Bordered Red Banner deputy lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 尋授散秩大臣，管理健銳營。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed Minister without Rank and placed in charge of the Vanguard Camp.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made minister without rank managing the Vanguard Camp.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 敖成，字丹九，陝西長安人。

translations.literal: Ao Cheng, style name Danjiu, was a native of Chang'an in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Ao Cheng, styled Danjiu, came from Chang'an in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 入伍，從征瞻對、金川、庫車，戰喀喇烏蘇河，攻葉爾羌，俱有功。

translations.literal: Entering the army, he followed campaigns in Daindu, Jinchuan, and Kucha, fought at the Karasu River, attacked Yarkand, all with merit.
translations.idiomatic: He enlisted and served in Daindu, Jinchuan, and Kucha, fought at Karasu River and Yarkand, all with credit.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十八年，師再徵金川，成以廣西右江鎮總兵入覲，上詢知成嘗出師瞻對、金川，賜花翎，並畀白金百，給驛詣軍前。

translations.literal: In the thirty-eighth year of Qianlong, when the army campaigned again against Jinchuan, Cheng was provincial commander of the Youjiang garrison in Guangxi on audience at court; the Emperor inquired and learned Cheng had campaigned in Daindu and Jinchuan, granted the peacock feather, and also gave one hundred taels of white silver and relay transport to proceed to the army front.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 38, Guangxi commander Ao Cheng was at court; learning he had served in Daindu and Jinchuan, the emperor gave him the peacock feather, one hundred taels of silver, and relay transport to the front.

sentences.zh: 旋移甘肅寧夏鎮，以將軍阿桂請，复移貴州鎮遠鎮。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was transferred to the Ningxia garrison in Gansu; at General Agui's request he was again transferred to the Zhenyuan garrison in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was shifted to Ningxia, then at Agui's request to Zhenyuan in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 師三道進，副將軍明亮出南路，請以成駐僧格宗防後路。

translations.literal: The army advanced in three columns; Deputy General Mingliang took the southern route and asked that Cheng garrison Senggezong to guard the rear.
translations.idiomatic: Three columns advanced; Mingliang on the south route asked Cheng to hold Senggezong in the rear.

sentences.zh: 上慮成未足當一面，命從明亮軍進討。

translations.literal: The Emperor feared Cheng was not equal to holding a front alone and ordered him to follow Mingliang's army in the advance.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor doubted he could hold a front alone and ordered him to follow Mingliang.

sentences.zh: 桂林疏言：「南路當自塔克撒至宜喜諸地設防。

translations.literal: Guilin memorialized: 'The southern route should be defended from Taksa to Yixi and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Guilin memorialized: "The southern route should be garrisoned from Taksa through Yixi."

sentences.zh: 成自薩穆果穆渡河，經美諾至塔克撒駐軍。

translations.literal: Cheng crossed the river from Samuguomu, passed through Meinuo to Taksa, and garrisoned troops there.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng crossed at Samuguomu, passed Meinuo, and encamped at Taksa.

sentences.zh: 」明亮移軍宜喜，攻達爾圖山梁，使成偕副都統舒景安率師攻日旁，奪賊卡二，破碉寨四百餘，殲賊甚眾。

translations.literal: ' Mingliang moved the army to Yixi and attacked Da'ertu Ridge, ordering Cheng together with Deputy Lieutenant-General Shujing'an to lead troops to attack Ribang, seized two rebel stockades, broke more than four hundred blockhouses and stockades, and killed very many rebels.
translations.idiomatic: " Mingliang moved to Yixi, assaulted Da'ertu Ridge, and sent Cheng with Shujing'an against Ribang, taking two stockades, over four hundred forts, and killing many rebels.

sentences.zh: 諸軍攻宜喜，圍合，诇甲索守賊皆老弱，當攻其瑕。

translations.literal: When the various armies attacked Yixi the encirclement closed; reconnaissance showed the Jiasuo garrison rebels were all old and weak and the weak point should be attacked.
translations.idiomatic: As Yixi was invested scouts found Jiasuo held only weak garrisons—the weak point to strike.

sentences.zh: 成偕副將常泰等率土、漢兵二千五百分三道進，破其要隘，先後奪碉十一。

translations.literal: Cheng with Deputy Commander Chang Tai and others led two thousand five hundred native and Han troops in three columns, broke their vital passes, and in succession seized eleven blockhouses.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng and Chang Tai led twenty-five hundred native and Han troops in three columns, broke key passes, and took eleven forts.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其勇，賜號僧格巴圖魯。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised his bravery and granted the title Senge Batüru.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his valor and gave him the title Senge Batüru.

sentences.zh: 復自達爾圖山梁進攻噶爾丹，直薄巴布里山脊。

translations.literal: Advancing again from Da'ertu Ridge against Ga'erdan, he pressed straight to the Babuli ridge.
translations.idiomatic: From Da'ertu Ridge he pressed on Ga'erdan toward the Babuli spine.

sentences.zh: 值夜大雪，潛師出碉後奮擊，連克防隘賊卡四。

translations.literal: A heavy snow fell at night; troops stole out behind the blockhouses and struck hard, capturing four defensive stockades in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In a night blizzard he slipped behind the forts and took four defensive stockades.

sentences.zh: 守碉賊驚潰，追斬無算。

translations.literal: The blockhouse garrison fled in alarm; pursuit killed beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison panicked and fled; pursuit killed beyond count.

sentences.zh: 复偕常泰攻克碾佔，偕提督馬彪率師至甲雜官砦，賊棄寨潰竄。

translations.literal: Again with Chang Tai he captured Nianzhan; with Provincial Commander Ma Biao he led troops to Jiaza official stockade and the rebels abandoned the stockade and fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: With Chang Tai he took Nianzhan; with Ma Biao he reached Jiaza stockade and the enemy ran.

sentences.zh: 師三路畢會，遂克噶喇依。

translations.literal: The army's three columns all joined and Galayi was captured.
translations.idiomatic: All three columns united and Galayi fell.

sentences.zh: 金川平，圖形紫光閣，列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: When Jinchuan was pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first fifty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinchuan his likeness joined the first fifty portraits.

sentences.zh: 御製贊，以乘雪取巴布里比諸李愬之入蔡州。

translations.literal: The Emperor composed praise comparing his snow assault on Babuli to Li Su's entry into Caizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's verse compared his snowy Babuli assault to Li Su's night entry into Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 擢貴州提督，入覲，賜黃馬褂。

translations.literal: He was promoted to provincial commander of Guizhou; on audience he was granted a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: He became Guizhou commander and received a yellow riding jacket at court.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈太子太保，諡勇愨，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: He died; posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous name Yongque and granted a hereditary office as Commandant of Light Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: He died, was posthumously made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent with the name Yongque, and granted a hereditary commandant of light cavalry.

sentences.zh: 圖欽保，瓜勒佳氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Tu Qin Bao, of the Guwalgiya clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Tu Qin Bao, of the Guwalgiya clan, belonged to the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 以前鋒校從將軍明瑞徵緬甸，有功，授三等侍衛，賜號法福禮巴圖魯。

translations.literal: As a vanguard corporal he followed General Mingrui against Burma with merit, was appointed a third-rank bodyguard, and granted the title Fafuri Batüru.
translations.idiomatic: As vanguard corporal under Mingrui in Burma he earned third-rank bodyguard and the title Fafuri Batüru.

sentences.zh: 遷健銳營副前鋒參領。

translations.literal: He was transferred to deputy vanguard colonel of the Vanguard Camp.
translations.idiomatic: He became deputy vanguard colonel of the Vanguard Camp.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十七年，從將軍阿桂徵金川，以皮船濟師，襲達烏西山碉卡。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of Qianlong he followed General Agui against Jinchuan; crossing the army by leather boats, he raided blockhouses and stockades on the western mountain of Dawu.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 37 he followed Agui in Jinchuan, ferried troops in skin boats, and raided Dawu's western forts.

sentences.zh: 圖欽保與總兵王萬邦自其左進，攻克其碉。

translations.literal: Tu Qin Bao with Commander Wang Wanbang advanced from the left and captured the blockhouse.
translations.idiomatic: With Wang Wanbang from the left he stormed the fort.

sentences.zh: 復與侍衛三寶等合兵，至邦甲山梁，緣溝以登，盡取諸碉卡，自山下夾攻，賊潰。

translations.literal: Again joining forces with Bodyguard Sanbao and others, they reached Bangjia Ridge, climbed along the ravine, took all blockhouses and stockades, and attacked from below on both sides; the rebels fled.
translations.idiomatic: With Sanbao he climbed Bangjia Ridge by the gorge, cleared every post, and pincered the enemy from below until they fled.

sentences.zh: 師至納圍納札木，副將軍明亮等分兵三道並進，圖欽保與游擊谷生炎攻山坡碉卡，賊力拒。

translations.literal: When the army reached Naweinazhamu, Deputy General Mingliang and others divided into three columns and advanced together; Tu Qin Bao with Guerrilla Commander Gu Shengyan attacked hillside blockhouses and stockades and the rebels resisted fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: At Naweinazhamu Mingliang's three columns advanced; Tu Qin Bao and Gu Shengyan stormed hillside forts against stiff resistance.

sentences.zh: 復與侍衛德赫布三面合圍，壘石卡逼賊，賊棄碉夜遁。

translations.literal: Again with Bodyguard Dehebu he surrounded on three sides, piled stone stockades to press the rebels, and the rebels abandoned the blockhouses and fled by night.
translations.idiomatic: With Dehebu he invested the enemy on three sides with stone breastworks until they abandoned the forts by night.

sentences.zh: 師進至僧格宗，圖欽保自河西科多渡橋攻河東，至喀咱木籠山梁，抵奢壟，賊奔美諾。

translations.literal: When the army advanced to Senggezong, Tu Qin Bao crossed the bridge at Kedu on the west bank of the river to attack the east bank, reached Kazhamulong Ridge, reached Shelung, and the rebels fled to Meinuo.
translations.idiomatic: At Senggezong he crossed at Kedu to the east bank, took Kazhamulong Ridge and Shelung, and drove the enemy toward Meinuo.

sentences.zh: 復與參領拉布棟阿以五百人取馬奈。

translations.literal: Again with Colonel Labudong'a he took Manai with five hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: With Colonel Labudong'a five hundred men took Manai.

sentences.zh: 擢湖南長沙協副將。

translations.literal: He was promoted to deputy commander of the Changsha garrison in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He was made deputy commander of Changsha garrison.

sentences.zh: 師復進，抵薩克薩谷，其北曰茹寨，麥方熟，賊設調以衛，圖欽保力攻克之，焚沿河各寨，賊竄出，中矢被槍及墜河死者無算，麥田十餘裡，皆為我兵所據。

translations.literal: When the army advanced again and reached Saksa Valley, to the north was Ru stockade where wheat was just ripe; the rebels set an ambush to guard it; Tu Qin Bao stormed and captured it, burned stockades along the river, rebels fled out, and those hit by arrows, guns, or who fell into the river died beyond counting; wheat fields for more than ten li were all occupied by our troops.
translations.idiomatic: At Saksa Valley he stormed Ru stockade amid ripe wheat, burned riverside posts, and slaughtered fleeing rebels; over ten li of fields fell to the army.

sentences.zh: 事聞，上手詔獎勉。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the Emperor personally issued an edict of praise and encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally praised him in edict.

sentences.zh: 復攻石真噶山下木城，毀賊寨，再進，攻扎烏古山梁，功最，擢陝西固原鎮總兵。

translations.literal: Advancing again he attacked the wooden fort below Shizheng'a Mountain, destroyed rebel stockades, advanced again and attacked Zhawugu Ridge with the greatest merit, and was promoted to commander of the Guyuan garrison in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He took the wooden fort below Shizheng'a, cleared more stockades, excelled at Zhawugu Ridge, and became Guyuan commander.

sentences.zh: 事定，圖形紫光閣，與德赫布並列前五十功臣。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor, ranked with Dehebu among the first fifty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: After the war his likeness joined the first fifty beside Dehebu.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，撒拉爾回叛，圖欽保將五百人助戰。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year the Salaer Muslims rebelled; Tu Qin Bao led five hundred men to assist in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In year 46 Salaer Muslims rebelled; he led five hundred auxiliaries.

sentences.zh: 賊退踞八蜡廟、水磨溝諸地，圖欽保從都統海蘭察率兵越水磨溝自山梁進逼賊巢。

translations.literal: The rebels retreated to hold Bala Miao, Shuimogou, and other places; Tu Qin Bao followed Lieutenant-General Hailanqa leading troops across Shuimogou and advanced along the ridge to press the rebel nest.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels held Bala Miao and Shuimogou; with Hailanqa he crossed Shuimogou along the ridge toward their lair.

sentences.zh: 賊自山坡逆上，圖欽保持刀奮戰，馬蹶，墜山下，被創，卒，賜白金七百。

translations.literal: Rebels came up the slope to meet them; Tu Qin Bao fought hard with saber in hand; his horse stumbled, he fell down the mountain, was wounded, and died; seven hundred taels of white silver were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels charged uphill; Tu Qin Bao fought with his saber until his horse fell, he tumbled down the slope, was wounded, and died; seven hundred taels of silver were granted.

sentences.zh: 木塔爾，小金川人。

translations.literal: Mu Ta Er was a native of Lesser Jinchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Ta Er was from Lesser Jinchuan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆三十七年，小金川頭人僧格桑為亂，拒我師，木塔爾率親屬及所部降。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year of Qianlong the Lesser Jinchuan chieftain Senggesan rebelled, resisted our army, and Mu Ta Er led relatives and his tribe to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 37 chieftain Senggesan rebelled; Mu Ta Er surrendered with kin and followers.

sentences.zh: 將軍溫福令從軍，即率土兵奪八角碉，降千餘人，复官寨。

translations.literal: General Wen Fu ordered him to follow the army; he immediately led native troops to seize Bajiao blockhouse, more than a thousand surrendered, and the official stockade was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu enrolled him; he led natives to take Bajiao fort, accepted over a thousand surrenders, and recovered the official stockade.

sentences.zh: 攻木果木，面中石傷。

translations.literal: Attacking Mugumu, he was struck in the face by a stone.
translations.idiomatic: At Mugumu a stone struck his face.

sentences.zh: 克達響谷山梁，槍傷額。

translations.literal: He captured Daxianggu Ridge and was wounded in the forehead by gunfire.
translations.idiomatic: He took Daxianggu Ridge and was shot in the forehead.

sentences.zh: 累擢三等侍衛，賜孔雀翎。

translations.literal: He rose in succession to third-rank bodyguard and was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to third-rank bodyguard with the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 僧格桑竄大金川，大金川頭人索諾木匿之，與同亂。

translations.literal: Senggesan fled into Greater Jinchuan; Greater Jinchuan chieftain Sonom hid him and joined the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Senggesan fled to Greater Jinchuan where Sonom sheltered him and joined the revolt.

sentences.zh: 將軍阿桂令木塔爾偵路，約內應，遂克阿不裡，招其叔朗納降。

translations.literal: General Agui ordered Mu Ta Er to reconnoiter routes and arrange inside contacts; they then captured Aboli and induced his uncle Langna to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Agui had him scout routes and arrange collaborators; Aboli fell and his uncle Langna submitted.

sentences.zh: 金川山徑歧互，阿桂令木塔爾指畫，繪圖呈覽；

translations.literal: Jinchuan mountain paths forked in many ways; Agui ordered Mu Ta Er to point them out and draw maps for presentation;
translations.idiomatic: Jinchuan trails were maze-like; Agui had him map them for the throne;

sentences.zh: 又以功噶爾拉賊守堅，諮木塔爾。

translations.literal: again, because Gongga'erla was stubbornly held by rebels, he consulted Mu Ta Er.
translations.idiomatic: when Gongga'erla held firm he consulted Mu Ta Er.

sentences.zh: 木塔爾言：「谷噶山路崎嶇，樹木深密。

translations.literal: Mu Ta Er said: 'The Guga road is rugged and the woods are dense.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Ta Er said: "The Guga road is rugged and wooded."

sentences.zh: 若密遣精兵畫伏夜行，出賊不意，亦一策也。

translations.literal: If elite troops are secretly sent to lie in ambush and march by night, taking the rebels unawares, that is also one plan.
translations.idiomatic: Elite troops could ambush by night and surprise the enemy—that too was a plan."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: They followed this advice.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was adopted.

sentences.zh: 戰有功。

translations.literal: He fought with merit.
translations.idiomatic: He fought with credit.

sentences.zh: 官兵護台站，遇賊稍卻。

translations.literal: Government troops guarding relay stations met rebels and fell back slightly.
translations.idiomatic: Guards at a relay station gave ground to rebels.

sentences.zh: 阿桂令木塔爾偕降人賡噶率土兵截擊，擒頭人穆工阿魯庫。

translations.literal: Agui ordered Mu Ta Er together with the surrendered man Gengga to lead native troops to intercept; they captured the leader Mugong Aluku.
translations.idiomatic: Agui sent Mu Ta Er and the surrender Gengga to intercept and seize leader Mugong Aluku.

sentences.zh: 攻噶魯什尼後山及登春諸地，擒頭人拉爾甲，創僧格爾結，以功賜緞。

translations.literal: Attacking the rear mountain of Galushini and Dengchun and other places, they captured the leader La'erjia, wounded Sengge'erjie, and for merit he was granted satin.
translations.idiomatic: At Galushini's rear slope and Dengchun they seized La'erjia, wounded Sengge'erjie, and won satin.

sentences.zh: 賊遣別斯滿尼僧布薄偽降，私詢木塔爾軍事，木塔爾密以聞。

translations.literal: Rebels sent Biesiman Ni Sengbu Bo to feign surrender and privately inquire about military affairs from Mu Ta Er; Mu Ta Er secretly reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels sent Biesiman Ni Sengbu Bo to feign surrender and probe Mu Ta Er, who reported it secretly.

sentences.zh: 上嘉其誠，果擢頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: The Emperor praised his loyalty and indeed promoted him to first-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his loyalty and promoted him to first-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 師攻喝拉依，索諾木等出降，賜號贊巴巴圖魯。

translations.literal: When the army attacked Galayi, Sonom and others came out to surrender and he was granted the title Zanba Batüru.
translations.idiomatic: At Galayi Sonom surrendered and he received the title Zanba Batüru.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣，列後五十功臣。

translations.literal: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the last fifty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: His likeness joined the last fifty portraits.

sentences.zh: 授八角碉屯守備，督帛噶爾角克及薩納木雅諸地降人屯田。

translations.literal: He was appointed garrison commander of Bajiao blockhouse and supervised surrendered people of Boge'erjiaoke and Sanamuya and other places in garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Bajiao garrison commander supervising surrendered farmers at Boge'erjiaoke and Sanamuya.

sentences.zh: 四十六年，甘肅撒拉爾回蘇四十三攻陷蘭州，上命領侍衛內大臣海蘭察軍討之，木塔爾從，中槍傷，賜銀緞。

translations.literal: In the forty-sixth year the Gansu Salaer Muslim Su Sishi attacked and took Lanzhou; the Emperor ordered Chamberlain of the Guard Hailanqa to lead an army to suppress them; Mu Ta Er followed, was wounded by gunfire, and satin and silver were granted.
translations.idiomatic: In year 46 Su Sishi took Lanzhou; Mu Ta Er followed Hailanqa, was shot, and received silver and satin.

sentences.zh: 復攻華林寺，再受傷，賜二品銜，以四川管理降番副將題補。

translations.literal: Attacking Hualin Temple again he was wounded again; second-rank rank was granted and he was nominated to fill the post of deputy commander managing surrendered Fan in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: At Hualin Temple he was wounded again, received second rank, and was slated for Sichuan's deputy commander over surrendered tribes.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，甘肅固原回田五等餘黨踞石峰堡，上命成都將軍保寧討之，木塔爾從，力疾赴調，賜散秩大臣銜。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year remnant bands of the Guyuan Muslim Tian Wu and others held Shifengbao in Gansu; the Emperor ordered General of Chengdu Baoning to suppress them; Mu Ta Er followed, went to answer the call despite illness, and was granted the rank of Minister without Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In year 49 Muslim remnants held Shifengbao; Mu Ta Er followed Baoning despite illness and received minister-without-rank rank.

sentences.zh: 至石峰堡，屢有斬獲，被石傷。

translations.literal: Reaching Shifengbao he repeatedly killed and captured; he was struck by a stone.
translations.idiomatic: At Shifengbao he took repeated heads and prisoners and was hit by a stone.

sentences.zh: 五十三年，從征台灣，偕侍衛博斌等生擒首逆莊大田於瑯嶠。

translations.literal: In the fifty-third year he followed the Taiwan campaign; together with Bodyguard Bobin and others he captured alive the chief rebel Zhuang Datian at Langqiao.
translations.idiomatic: In year 53 on Taiwan he and Bobin captured Zhuang Datian alive at Langqiao.

sentences.zh: 台灣平，复圖形紫光閣，列前二十功臣。

translations.literal: When Taiwan was pacified, his portrait was again placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the first twenty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: After Taiwan his likeness joined the first twenty portraits.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，廓爾喀為亂，攻陷聶拉木。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year the Gurkhas rebelled and captured Nyalam.
translations.idiomatic: In year 56 the Gurkhas took Nyalam.

sentences.zh: 木塔爾從成德守木薩橋，獲頭人格枌達喀嘰哈等，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: Mu Ta Er followed Cheng De in guarding the Musa Bridge, captured the chiefs Gefendakajiha and others, and was given the rank of deputy lieutenant-general.
translations.idiomatic: With Cheng De at Musa Bridge he seized chiefs including Gefendakajiha and gained deputy lieutenant-general rank.

sentences.zh: 師攻濟嚨，木塔爾偕侍衛哲森保先攻克東南山梁，移兵逐賊，复濟嚨，殲賊數百，殪賊目七。

translations.literal: When the army attacked Jilong, Mu Ta Er with Bodyguard Zhe Sen Bao first captured the southeast mountain ridge, moved troops to pursue rebels, recovered Jilong, killed several hundred rebels, and killed seven rebel officers.
translations.idiomatic: At Jilong he and Zhe Sen Bao first took the southeast ridge, pursued rebels, retook Jilong, killed hundreds, and seven rebel officers.

sentences.zh: 師攻雅爾賽拉、博爾東拉，木塔爾率兵自噶多普紆道渡河，奪石卡、木城。

translations.literal: When the army attacked Ya'ersaila and Bo'erdongla, Mu Ta Er led troops from Gaduopu by a winding route across the river and seized stone stockades and wooden forts.
translations.idiomatic: At Ya'ersaila and Bo'erdongla he crossed by Gaduopu's winding route and took stone and wooden forts.

sentences.zh: 廓爾喀平，再圖形紫光閣，列後十五功臣。

translations.literal: When the Gurkhas were pacified, his portrait was again placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the last fifteen meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: After the Gurkha war his likeness joined the last fifteen portraits.

sentences.zh: 上特召慰勞，賜酒，賚銀緞。

translations.literal: The Emperor specially summoned him to comfort and encourage him, granted wine, and bestowed silver and satin.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned him personally, gave wine, silver, and satin.

sentences.zh: 六十年，從征苗匪。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year he followed the campaign against Miao bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In year 60 he campaigned against Miao rebels.

sentences.zh: 賊居下石花、土空等處，循沿河山坡築城卡，阻我師。

translations.literal: The rebels held Xiaoshihua, Tukong, and other places, building forts and stockades along the riverside slopes to block our army.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels at Xiaoshihua and Tukong built slope forts along the river to block the army.

sentences.zh: 總督福康安遣木塔爾於下游河岸設伏，賊出卡搶掠，突出擊之，奪其渡船。

translations.literal: Governor-General Fuk'ang'an sent Mu Ta Er to set an ambush on the downstream riverbank; when rebels came out of the stockade to plunder he burst out and struck, seizing their ferry boats.
translations.idiomatic: Fuk'ang'an ambushed him downstream; when rebels raided he seized their boats.

sentences.zh: 師進迫之，賊不能禦，連克城卡。

translations.literal: The army advanced in pursuit; the rebels could not resist and forts and stockades were taken in succession.
translations.idiomatic: The army pressed on and forts fell in succession.

sentences.zh: 進攻土空，偕總兵花連布等連戰三畫夜，破之，賜荷包。

translations.literal: Advancing against Tukong, together with Commander Hualianbu and others he fought for three days and nights and broke it; a purse was granted.
translations.idiomatic: At Tukong he and Hualianbu fought three days and nights to break the position and received an imperial purse.

sentences.zh: 以病還師，至資陽，道卒，賜白金百。

translations.literal: Because of illness he returned with the army; on the road at Ziyang he died on the way; one hundred taels of white silver were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Illness forced his return; he died on the road at Ziyang and received one hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 岱森保，庫雅拉闊綽里氏，滿洲正紅旗人。

translations.literal: Dai Sen Bao, of the Kuyala Kuochuoli clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Sen Bao, of the Kuyala Kuochuoli clan, belonged to the Manchu Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 以黏竿處拜唐阿從征緬甸。

translations.literal: As a bannerman of the Fishing-Rod Office he followed the campaign against Burma.
translations.idiomatic: From the Fishing-Rod Office he served in the Burma campaign.

sentences.zh: 移師徵金川，與攻路頂宗、喀木色爾，授藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: When the army shifted to campaign against Jinchuan, he fought at Ludingzong and Kamuse'er and was appointed a blue-lance bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jinchuan shift he fought at Ludingzong and Kamuse'er and became a blue-lance bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 戰於昔嶺，賊乘高而下，以火器奮擊，賊潰，授三等侍衛。

translations.literal: Fighting at Xiling, rebels came down from the heights and struck fiercely with firearms; the rebels fled and he was appointed a third-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: At Xiling rebels swept down with guns; after routing them he became third-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 戰於羅博瓦，殲賊數十，复奪取喀木喇瑪山碉，擢二等侍衛，賜號布隆巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Fighting at Luobowa, he killed several dozen rebels and again captured the Kamulama Mountain blockhouse; he was promoted to second-rank bodyguard and granted the title Bulong Batüru.
translations.idiomatic: At Luobowa he killed dozens and retook Kamulama fort, becoming second-rank bodyguard with the title Bulong Batüru.

sentences.zh: 攻勒吉爾博山梁，拔鹿角，躍壕，以火彈擲碉巔，破之。

translations.literal: Attacking Leji'erbo Ridge, he pulled up abatis, leaped the moat, and threw fire bombs to the blockhouse summit and broke it.
translations.idiomatic: At Leji'erbo Ridge he tore up abatis, leaped the ditch, and fire-bombed the fort summit into ruin.

sentences.zh: 從將軍阿桂攻勒烏圍，發砲斷其橋，隧以入柵，克木城，與諸軍合攻，勒烏圍遂下，授頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: Following General Agui in the attack on Lewuwei, he fired cannon and broke their bridge, then tunneled through to enter the palisade, captured the wooden fort, joined the various armies in the assault, and Lewuwei fell; he was appointed a first-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: With Agui at Lewuwei he shelled the bridge, tunneled into the palisade, took the wooden fort, and helped bring Lewuwei down; he became first-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 師還，圖形紫光閣，列後五十功臣。

translations.literal: When the army withdrew, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the last fifty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: On withdrawal his likeness joined the last fifty portraits.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十四年，以護軍參領從征台灣。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year of Qianlong he followed the Taiwan campaign as guard colonel.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 44 he campaigned in Taiwan as guard colonel.

sentences.zh: 與侍衛烏什哈達等擊賊沙嵌，進至蔦松，殲賊二百餘。

translations.literal: Together with Bodyguard Wu Shenhada and others he struck rebels at Shaqian, advanced to Niaosong, and annihilated more than two hundred rebels.
translations.idiomatic: With Wu Shenhada he hit Shaqian, reached Niaosong, and killed over two hundred rebels.

sentences.zh: 擊賊中洲，發巨砲殺賊，進擊賊南潭，賊潰，焚賊藔數百。

translations.literal: Striking rebels at Zhongzhou, he fired great cannon and killed rebels, advanced to attack the rebel Nantan, the rebels fled, and several hundred rebel huts were burned.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhongzhou his heavy guns broke the enemy; at Nantan rebels fled and hundreds of huts burned.

sentences.zh: 再進，擊賊三坎店，奪賊中砲械。

translations.literal: Advancing again, he struck rebels at Sankandian and seized rebel cannon and weapons from the center.
translations.idiomatic: He next took Sankandian and captured enemy guns and arms.

sentences.zh: 尋從閩浙總督常青等援諸羅，出鹽水港，戰賊屢勝，賜副都統銜。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he followed Zhejiang-Fujian Governor-General Chang Qing and others to relieve Zhuluo, came out from Yanshui Harbor, fought rebels with repeated victories, and was granted the rank of deputy lieutenant-general.
translations.idiomatic: He relieved Zhuluo with Chang Qing from Yanshui Harbor, won repeatedly, and received deputy lieutenant-general rank.

sentences.zh: 福康安視師，岱森保攻賊牛莊，賊阻溪為固，督兵逾溪擊之，俘斬甚眾，乘銳抵南潭，遂俘莊大田等。

translations.literal: When Fuk'ang'an took command of the army, Dai Sen Bao attacked the rebel Niuzhuang; rebels blocked the stream as a defense; he directed troops across the stream to strike them, captured and killed very many, pressed with sharp momentum to Nantan, and then captured Zhuang Datian and others.
translations.idiomatic: Under Fuk'ang'an he stormed Niuzhuang, crossed the stream the enemy had fortified, swept to Nantan, and captured Zhuang Datian.

sentences.zh: 師旋，再圖形紫光閣，列後三十功臣。

translations.literal: When the army returned, his portrait was again placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the last thirty meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: On return his likeness joined the last thirty portraits.

sentences.zh: 擢正黃旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: He was promoted to deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He became Plain Yellow Banner deputy lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 出為伊犁領隊大臣。

translations.literal: He went out to serve as leading minister at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: He was posted leading minister at Ili.

sentences.zh: 廓爾喀為亂，上命岱森保將索倫、達呼爾兵千人，偕參贊大臣海蘭察自京師道青海入西藏，佐福康安等討之。

translations.literal: When the Gurkhas rebelled, the Emperor ordered Dai Sen Bao to lead one thousand Solon and Daur troops, together with Consultant Hailanqa from the capital by the Qinghai route into Tibet, to assist Fuk'ang'an and others in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: When Gurkhas rebelled the emperor sent him with a thousand Solon and Daur troops and Hailanqa through Qinghai into Tibet under Fuk'ang'an.

sentences.zh: 既至，福康安令偕成都將軍成德將三千人向聶拉木綴賊。

translations.literal: When they arrived, Fuk'ang'an ordered him together with General of Chengdu Cheng De to lead three thousand men toward Nyalam to pin the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Fuk'ang'an paired him with Cheng De and three thousand men to fix Nyalam.

sentences.zh: 分兵自措克沙木間道入，自率兵趨親鼎山，破賊卡，賊敗竄。

translations.literal: Dividing troops to enter by a side path from Cuoqishamu, he himself led troops toward Qinding Mountain, broke rebel stockades, and the rebels were defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: He sent a column through Cuoqishamu while he took Qinding Mountain, broke enemy posts, and routed the Gurkhas.

sentences.zh: 旋偕侍衛永德道哈那滾木山，克扎木。

translations.literal: Soon afterward together with Bodyguard Yongde he took the Hamagunmu Mountain road and captured Zhamu.
translations.idiomatic: With Yongde he took the Hamagunmu route and captured Zhamu.

sentences.zh: 复偕成德敗賊多洛卡，追躡至俄賴巴，分兵兩路深入，廓爾喀酋降。

translations.literal: Again with Cheng De he defeated rebels at Duoluoka, pursued to Elaiba, divided troops in two columns to advance deep inside, and the Gurkha chief surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: With Cheng De he beat Duoluoka, pursued to Elaiba, split columns deep inland, and the Gurkha chief submitted.

sentences.zh: 复圖形紫光閣，列後十五功臣。

translations.literal: His portrait was again placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the last fifteen meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: His likeness joined the last fifteen portraits.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，教匪起，命岱森保討賊陝、甘。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiaqing, when sectarian rebels rose, Dai Sen Bao was ordered to suppress rebels in Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jiaqing he was ordered to fight sectarians in Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 張漢潮侵五郎，自盩厔出大建溝擾洵陽，偕總兵長春、副都統綸布春隨所在御之。

translations.literal: Zhang Hanchao invaded Wulang; coming out from Zhouzhi by Dajian Ravine he disturbed Xunyang; together with Commander Changchun and Deputy Lieutenant-General Lunbuchun he resisted wherever they went.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hanchao raided from Zhouzhi into Xunyang; with Changchun and Lunbuchun he met them wherever they struck.

sentences.zh: 上責肅清甘肅境，與西安巡撫台佈選能戰兵四千有奇，逐賊轉戰，屢有克捷。

translations.literal: The Emperor rebuked him for not clearing Gansu territory; together with Xi'an Governor Taibu he selected more than four thousand troops able to fight, pursued rebels in successive battles, and repeatedly won victories.
translations.idiomatic: Rebuked for failing to clear Gansu, he and Governor Taibu fielded four thousand fighters and won repeated engagements.

sentences.zh: 五年秋，擊賊沔縣，以兵寡未獲窮追，還軍駐長寨。

translations.literal: In autumn of the fifth year he struck rebels at Mian county; because troops were few he could not pursue to the end and returned to garrison at Changzhai.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn of year 5 he fought at Mian county but, too few to finish the pursuit, fell back to Changzhai.

sentences.zh: 疾作，行至漢中，卒。

translations.literal: Illness came on; traveling to Hanzhong he died on the way.
translations.idiomatic: He fell ill and died on the road to Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 翁果爾海，噶巴喀氏，滿洲鑲黃旗人。

translations.literal: Weng Guoerhai, of the Gabaka clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Guoerhai, of the Gabaka clan, belonged to the Manchu Bordered Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 初充親軍，遷藍翎侍衛。

translations.literal: At first he served as an imperial guardsman and was transferred to blue-lance bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He began as an imperial guardsman and became a blue-lance bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十二年，從福康安徵台灣，擊賊八卦山，斬馘無算，賜號額騰額巴圖魯。

translations.literal: In the fifty-second year of Qianlong he followed Fuk'ang'an against Taiwan, attacked rebels at Bagua Mountain, killed and captured beyond counting, and was granted the title Eteng'e Batüru.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 52 he followed Fuk'ang'an in Taiwan, fought at Bagua Mountain with great slaughter, and received the title Eteng'e Batüru.

sentences.zh: 累遷二等侍衛。

translations.literal: He rose in succession to second-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to second-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 林爽文遁老衢峙，義民高振以告。

translations.literal: Lin Shuangwen fled to Laoquzhi; righteous commoner Gao Zhen informed on him.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Shuangwen fled to Laoquzhi; loyalist Gao Zhen reported him.

sentences.zh: 翁果爾海與追擊，獲之。

translations.literal: Weng Guoerhai joined the pursuit and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Guoerhai pursued and captured him.

sentences.zh: 台灣平，予騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: When Taiwan was pacified he was granted a hereditary office as Commandant of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: After Taiwan he received a hereditary commandant of cavalry.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，廓爾喀侵後藏，從將軍福康安、參贊海蘭察往討之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year the Gurkhas invaded rear Tibet; he followed General Fuk'ang'an and Consultant Hailanqa to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: In year 56 Gurkhas invaded rear Tibet; he followed Fuk'ang'an and Hailanqa.

sentences.zh: 賊據擦木，其地兩山夾峙，惟一徑可通。

translations.literal: The rebels held Camu; the place had two mountains facing each other with only one path passable.
translations.idiomatic: At Camu two mountains faced each other with only one pass.

sentences.zh: 夜雨，翁果爾海分兵潛進，越山直上山梁，與師會，薄賊寨，踰牆入，殲賊數百，克其碉。

translations.literal: Rain fell at night; Weng Guoerhai divided troops to steal in secretly, crossed the mountain straight to the ridge, joined the army, pressed the rebel stockade, climbed over the wall and entered, annihilated several hundred rebels, and captured their blockhouse.
translations.idiomatic: In night rain he stole over the ridge, joined the main force, scaled the wall, killed hundreds, and took the fort.

sentences.zh: 賊奪據濟嚨官寨，師圍之。

translations.literal: The rebels seized and held the Jilong official stockade; the army invested it.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels seized Jilong official stockade and the army besieged it.

sentences.zh: 翁果爾海直攻東南山梁，賊恃碉拒師；

translations.literal: Weng Guoerhai attacked the southeast mountain ridge directly; rebels relied on blockhouses to resist the army;
translations.idiomatic: He struck Jilong's southeast ridge directly while rebels held forts;

sentences.zh: 督兵緣碉上，殲賊六百餘，擢頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: he directed troops up along the blockhouses and killed more than six hundred rebels; he was promoted to first-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: he climbed the forts and killed over six hundred; he was made first-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 賊據熱索橋，師自擺馬奈撒入，與夾河相持。

translations.literal: The rebels held Resuo Bridge; the army entered from Baimanai Sa and faced each other across the river.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels held Resuo Bridge; the army entered from Baimanai Sa and faced them across the river.

sentences.zh: 翁果爾海自峨綠山紆道出上游，斫木編筏潛濟，自間道疾馳攻賊寨，師悉渡，賜副都統銜。

translations.literal: Weng Guoerhai came out by a winding route from E'lv Mountain upstream, felled trees to weave rafts and crossed secretly, rushed by a side path to attack the rebel stockade, the army all crossed, and he was granted the rank of deputy lieutenant-general.
translations.idiomatic: From E'lv Mountain upstream he rafted across secretly, stormed the enemy stockade by a side path, got the whole army over, and received deputy lieutenant-general rank.

sentences.zh: 賊竄協布魯，負水築卡為守，師不得即渡，暮雨，伏兵林中，夜將半，援木涉水進擊。

translations.literal: The rebels fled to Xiebulu, built stockades backed by water as defense, and the army could not cross immediately; at evening rain fell, troops lay in ambush in the woods, and near midnight they supported themselves on logs to wade the water and strike.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels held Xiebulu behind water; in evening rain troops ambushed in the woods and at midnight waded in on logs.

sentences.zh: 師繞出對山，並力下攻，賊潰走，追斬三百餘，焚寨五；

translations.literal: The army circled to the opposite mountain and attacked downward with combined strength; the rebels fled in rout; pursuit killed more than three hundred and burned five stockades;
translations.idiomatic: The army swung to the opposite height and charged down; over three hundred were killed and five stockades burned;

sentences.zh: 遂進攻東覺，道噶多。

translations.literal: then they advanced against Dongjue along the Daoduo route.
translations.idiomatic: then they advanced on Dongjue by Daoduo.

sentences.zh: 翁果爾海從海蘭察為前鋒，紆道出雅爾賽拉、博爾東拉，穿林越箐，潛師步行。

translations.literal: Weng Guoerhai with Hailanqa as vanguard wound out by routes to Ya'ersaila and Bo'erdongla, passed through woods and over ravines, and troops marched secretly on foot.
translations.idiomatic: With Hailanqa as vanguard he threaded Ya'ersaila and Bo'erdongla through forest and ravine on foot.

sentences.zh: 賊為木城​​三、石卡七，守甚堅。

translations.literal: The rebels had three wooden forts and seven stone stockades, defended very stubbornly.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy held three wooden forts and seven stone posts with stubborn defense.

sentences.zh: 翁果爾海督兵逾險攻之，右臂創甚劇，援兵至，奮勇轉戰，殪頭人二、餘賊二百有奇，賊乃遁，悉隳其城卡，賜白金五十。

translations.literal: Weng Guoerhai directed troops to attack over dangerous ground; his right arm was gravely wounded; when relieving troops arrived he fought hard in renewed battle, killed two leaders and more than two hundred other rebels; the rebels then fled and all their forts and stockades were destroyed; fifty taels of white silver were granted.
translations.idiomatic: He led an assault over deadly ground, was badly wounded in the right arm, rallied when reinforcements came, killed two leaders and over two hundred men, and destroyed every fort; fifty taels of silver were granted.

sentences.zh: 廓爾喀平，圖形紫光閣，列後十五功臣。

translations.literal: When the Gurkhas were pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the last fifteen meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: After the Gurkha war his likeness joined the last fifteen portraits.

sentences.zh: 授鑲黃旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: He was appointed deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He became Bordered Yellow Banner deputy lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，卒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jiaqing he died.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Jiaqing he died.

sentences.zh: 珠爾杭阿，顏扎氏，滿洲正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Zhu Er Hang A, of the Yanja clan, was a Manchu of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Er Hang A, of the Yanja clan, belonged to the Manchu Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 自前鋒累擢二等侍衛。

translations.literal: From vanguard he rose in succession to second-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from vanguard to second-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 從征甘肅石峰堡亂回，賜號錫利巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Following the campaign against the Muslim rebels at Shifengbao in Gansu, he was granted the title Xili Batüru.
translations.idiomatic: In the Shifengbao Muslim campaign he received the title Xili Batüru.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十六年，廓爾喀侵後藏。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year of Qianlong the Gurkhas invaded rear Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 56 the Gurkhas invaded rear Tibet.

sentences.zh: 上命鄂輝、成德討之，命珠​​爾杭阿佐軍，鄂輝以第理浪古、窩浪卡兩地當衝要，令珠爾杭阿察形勢，督兵屯守。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered E Hui and Cheng De to suppress them and ordered Zhu Er Hang A to assist the army; E Hui, because Dili Langgu and Wolangka were vital points, ordered Zhu Er Hang A to reconnoiter the terrain and direct troops to garrison them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent E Hui and Cheng De with Zhu Er Hang A as assistant; E Hui had him scout and garrison Dili Langgu and Wolangka.

sentences.zh: 尋偕侍衛永德攻克聶拉木寨，賜大緞。

translations.literal: Soon afterward together with Bodyguard Yongde he captured Nyalam stockade and was granted large satin.
translations.idiomatic: With Yongde he soon took Nyalam stockade and received large satin.

sentences.zh: 复偕將軍福康安自宗喀攻擦木，與參贊大臣海蘭察合軍，自正路攻賊寨，克之，賜大小荷包。

translations.literal: Again together with General Fuk'ang'an he attacked Camu from Zongka; joining Consultant Hailanqa's army they attacked the rebel stockade by the main road and captured it; large and small purses were granted.
translations.idiomatic: With Fuk'ang'an from Zongka and Hailanqa on the main road he took Camu and received imperial purses.

sentences.zh: 復同頭等侍衛阿滿泰等克濟嚨，遷頭等侍衛。

translations.literal: Again together with first-rank bodyguard A Mantai and others he captured Jilong and was transferred to first-rank bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: With A Mantai he took Jilong and became first-rank bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 復從海蘭察攻雅爾賽拉、博爾東拉，毀木城、石卡，殲賊甚眾。

translations.literal: Again following Hailanqa he attacked Ya'ersaila and Bo'erdongla, destroyed wooden forts and stone stockades, and killed very many rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Again with Hailanqa he smashed wooden forts and stone posts at Ya'ersaila and Bo'erdongla.

sentences.zh: 又破賊於瑪木拉，加副都統銜。

translations.literal: Again he defeated rebels at Mamula and was given the rank of deputy lieutenant-general.
translations.idiomatic: He beat the enemy at Mamula and received deputy lieutenant-general rank.

sentences.zh: 進攻噶勒拉堆補木大山，分兵三路，珠爾杭阿偕三等侍衛阿哈保等自右路夾擊，焚賊卡。

translations.literal: Advancing against Galeladuibu Mountain, forces divided into three columns; Zhu Er Hang A with third-rank bodyguard Ahabao and others struck from the right in concert and burned rebel stockades.
translations.idiomatic: At Galeladuibu Mountain in three columns he and Ahabao flanked from the right and burned enemy posts.

sentences.zh: 復自橫河上游修橋渡，攻集木集，克之，尋命為領隊。

translations.literal: Again from the upper Henghe River they built a bridge to cross, attacked Jimuji and captured it; soon afterward he was ordered to serve as leading minister.
translations.idiomatic: They bridged the upper Henghe, took Jimuji, and he was made leading minister.

sentences.zh: 廓爾喀頭人拉特納巴都爾降。

translations.literal: The Gurkha leader Ratnabadur surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Gurkha leader Ratnabadur surrendered.

sentences.zh: 福康安令珠爾杭阿護貢使詣京師。

translations.literal: Fuk'ang'an ordered Zhu Er Hang A to escort the tribute envoys to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Fuk'ang'an had him escort tribute envoys to the capital.

sentences.zh: 圖形紫光閣，列後十五功臣。

translations.literal: His portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the last fifteen meritorious officials.
translations.idiomatic: His likeness joined the last fifteen portraits.

sentences.zh: 累遷御前侍衛、正白旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: He rose in succession to bodyguard of the imperial presence and commander of the guards of the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to imperial bodyguard and Plain White Banner guard commander.

sentences.zh: 神武門獲為逆者陳德，賜騎都尉世職，授鑲藍旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: At the Divine Martial Gate he captured the rebel Chen De; he was granted a hereditary office as Commandant of Cavalry and appointed deputy lieutenant-general of the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: At the Divine Martial Gate he seized rebel Chen De, received a hereditary commandant of cavalry, and became Bordered Blue Banner deputy lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 哲森保，薩克達氏，滿洲鑲藍旗人。

translations.literal: Zhe Sen Bao, of the Sakda clan, was a Manchu of the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhe Sen Bao, of the Sakda clan, belonged to the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 初充吉林烏拉馬甲。

translations.literal: At first he served as a Jilin ula horse guard.
translations.idiomatic: He first served as a Jilin ula horse guard.

sentences.zh: 徵緬甸，偕侍衛阿爾蘇拉擊賊新街，從副都統明亮擊賊老官屯。

translations.literal: In the Burma campaign, together with Bodyguard A'ersula he struck rebels at Xinjie and followed Deputy Lieutenant-General Mingliang in striking rebels at Laoguantun.
translations.idiomatic: In Burma he and A'ersula fought at Xinjie and followed Mingliang at Laoguantun.

sentences.zh: 從討王倫，侍衛音濟圖擒賊，將就縛，突有賊持械出拒，哲森保射殺之。

translations.literal: Following the suppression of Wang Lun, Bodyguard Yinjitü captured a rebel and was about to bind him when suddenly a rebel came out with weapons to resist; Zhe Sen Bao shot and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Against Wang Lun, when Yinjitü was binding a prisoner a rebel rushed out; Zhe Sen Bao shot him dead.

sentences.zh: 從討蘇四十三，攻華林山，槍殪賊渠，哲森保亦被創，賜號法福里巴圖魯。

translations.literal: Following the suppression of Su Sishi, attacking Hualin Mountain he shot and killed the rebel chief with a gun; Zhe Sen Bao was also wounded and was granted the title Fafuri Batüru.
translations.idiomatic: Against Su Sishi at Hualin Mountain he shot the rebel chief, was wounded himself, and received Fafuri Batüru.

sentences.zh: 累擢二等侍衛、乾清門行走。

translations.literal: He rose in succession to second-rank bodyguard and attendant at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to second-rank bodyguard and attendant at the Gate of Heavenly Purity.

sentences.zh: 再出討石峰亂回，中石傷，擢頭等侍衛，授公中佐領。

translations.literal: Campaigning again against the Shifengbao Muslim rebels, he was struck by a stone, was promoted to first-rank bodyguard, and was appointed company commander in the imperial guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the Shifengbao Muslim war a stone wounded him; he became first-rank bodyguard and imperial guard company commander.

sentences.zh: 從征廓爾喀，攻擦木。

translations.literal: Following the Gurkha campaign he attacked Camu.
translations.idiomatic: In the Gurkha war he attacked Camu.

sentences.zh: 哲森保與翁果爾海各將一隊，自東、西兩山分進，克之。

translations.literal: Zhe Sen Bao and Weng Guoerhai each led one column, advancing from the east and west mountains respectively, and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: He and Weng Guoerhai took Camu in columns from east and west.

sentences.zh: 攻濟嚨，首奪東南山梁；

translations.literal: Attacking Jilong, he was first to seize the southeast mountain ridge;
translations.idiomatic: At Jilong he was first on the southeast ridge;

sentences.zh: 師繼進，遂克濟嚨官寨。

translations.literal: the army advanced in succession and then captured the Jilong official stockade.
translations.idiomatic: the army followed and took Jilong official stockade.

sentences.zh: 賊斷熱索橋，哲森保與阿滿泰出間道，越峨綠山，自上游砍樹結筏潛渡，驟攻賊卡，賊駭愕奔竄，師得濟，賜副都統銜。

translations.literal: The rebels cut Resuo Bridge; Zhe Sen Bao with A Mantai came out by a side path, crossed E'lv Mountain, felled trees upstream to weave rafts and crossed secretly, suddenly attacked rebel stockades, the rebels fled in shock, the army was able to cross, and he was granted the rank of deputy lieutenant-general.
translations.idiomatic: When Resuo Bridge was cut he and A Mantai rafted secretly from E'lv Mountain upstream, stormed enemy posts, and got the army across for deputy lieutenant-general rank.

sentences.zh: 至博爾東拉，與賊力戰，左膝中槍，賜白金百，令還濟嚨休養。

translations.literal: Reaching Bo'erdongla he fought hard with rebels; his left knee was struck by gunfire; one hundred taels of white silver were granted and he was ordered back to Jilong to recuperate.
translations.idiomatic: At Bo'erdongla he was shot in the left knee, received one hundred taels of silver, and was sent to recuperate at Jilong.

sentences.zh: 至協布魯，創發，卒。

translations.literal: Reaching Xiebulu his wounds reopened and he died.
translations.idiomatic: At Xiebulu his wounds reopened and he died.

sentences.zh: 廓爾喀平，圖形紫光閣，列後十五功臣，祀昭忠祠，賜騎都尉世職。

translations.literal: When the Gurkhas were pacified, his portrait was placed in the Hall of Purple Splendor among the last fifteen meritorious officials, he was enshrined in the Temple of Loyalty and Righteousness, and a hereditary office as Commandant of Cavalry was granted.
translations.idiomatic: After the Gurkha war his likeness joined the last fifteen portraits; he was enshrined at the Temple of Loyalty and Righteousness with a hereditary commandant of cavalry.

sentences.zh: 子富永，亦在軍，以戰功累擢三等侍衛，襲職。

translations.literal: His son Fuyong was also in the army; for military merit he rose in succession to third-rank bodyguard and inherited the office.
translations.idiomatic: His son Fuyong also served, rose to third-rank bodyguard, and inherited the office.

sentences.zh: 官至鑲黃旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: He reached the office of deputy lieutenant-general of the Mongol Bordered Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He became Bordered Yellow Banner deputy lieutenant-general.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：金川地小而險，懸崖絕壁，壘石為碉，師至不能下。

translations.literal: The commentator says: Jinchuan territory is small yet perilous, with hanging cliffs and sheer walls; piling stone into blockhouses, when the army arrives it cannot descend.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator observes: Jinchuan was small but deadly—cliffs and stone forts the army could not readily storm.

sentences.zh: 高宗讀太宗實錄，知其時攻城用雲梯，命斅其制，督八旗子弟習焉。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozong read the Veritable Records of Taizong and learned that in that time siege ladders were used in storming cities; he ordered the model copied and supervised banner sons and brothers to practice them.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozong read Taizong's Veritable Records, revived siege-ladder methods, and trained banner youths in them.

sentences.zh: 師再出攻碉，賴是以濟。

translations.literal: When the army went out again to attack blockhouses, it was by this means that they succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Those ladders made the second blockhouse campaign possible.

sentences.zh: 諸將有勞者，五福將四川兵，彪將貴州兵，常青將雲南兵，成將綠營，木塔爾將土兵，餘皆率禁旅；

translations.literal: Among the generals with merit, Wu Fu led Sichuan troops, Ma Biao led Guizhou troops, Chang Qing led Yunnan troops, Cheng led Green Standard troops, Mu Ta Er led native troops, and the rest all led the Forbidden Troops;
translations.idiomatic: Wu Fu commanded Sichuan troops, Ma Biao Guizhou, Chang Qing Yunnan, Cheng the Green Standard, Mu Ta Er native levies, and the rest the Forbidden Troops;

sentences.zh: 而官達色督砲兵，圖欽保佐健銳營，尤專主攻碉，摧堅決險，非豫不為功。

translations.literal: while Guan Da Se directed artillery troops and Tu Qin Bao assisted the Vanguard Camp, especially specializing in storming blockhouses, breaking strongpoints and perilous ground—without preparation they achieved no merit.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Da Se commanded artillery and Tu Qin Bao the Vanguard Camp, both specialists in reducing forts where preparation decided success.

sentences.zh: 成德、岱森保及木塔爾復從徵廓爾喀有功。

translations.literal: Cheng De, Dai Sen Bao, and Mu Ta Er again followed the Gurkha campaign with merit.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng De, Dai Sen Bao, and Mu Ta Er later distinguished themselves against the Gurkhas.

sentences.zh: 翁果爾海等未與金川之役，而屢從征伐，轉戰立勳名，亦裨佐之良也。

translations.literal: Weng Guoerhai and others did not take part in the Jinchuan campaign, yet repeatedly followed campaigns, fighting in succession and establishing merit and fame—they too were fine assistants.
translations.idiomatic: Weng Guoerhai and others missed Jinchuan yet served in many later wars with honor—they too were excellent lieutenants.
